title: [*] Core : Please consider removing useless Addons filter on modules list
issue_title: [*] Core : Please consider removing useless Addons filter on modules list
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Currently, the modules which are put directly in the "modules" directory do not appear on the modules list in the administration panel, so they can't be install. This limitation is useless since merchants can still upload a zipped module via "Upload a module". It's only annoying for developers that must zip their modules to install them. It become very difficult to run some simple tests on module such like install / uninstall (when they are not on Addons). Moreover, a merchant who have a module installed, if he choose to uninstall it temporarly, he will not be able to reinstall it (or will have to download it via ftp, zip it, and reupload it). Please consider removing this limit, since it won't improve security or Addons experience. |

### Steps to reproduce
Just put a module that is not on Addons in the "modules" directory of PrestaShop and see if it appears |

title: Fix some of the functions on the product page (JS)
issue_title: Fix some of the functions on the product page (JS)
issue_body:
### Describe the bug If Prestashop is installed in a subdirectory whose name starts with a number, the JS will incorrectly modify the links that occur requests for data processing. Thus, you can not delete the file in the virtual product can not attach a file to the product, can not see the list of product combinations, can not change the type of product (with the removal of all combinations), can not add a feature to the product (at is possible to obtain a list of values). ### Steps to reproduce The problem is the regular expression used. If prestashop installed on www.site.com/17prestashop/ address (for example), www.site.com/17prestashop/feature/get-feature-values/1 requests for the product with the number 8, will be converted to www.site.com/8prestashop/feature/get-feature-values/1, instead of www.site.com/17prestashop/feature/get-feature-values/8 . Therefore it is necessary to change the regular expression (I added a question mark in it, as a token to be necessarily).
with old regex - https://regex101.com/r/5Nxxyx/1
with new regex https://regex101.com/r/5Nxxyx/2

### Describe the bug If a shop is multi-currency and customer pays in an other than the default, the valid orders amount is displaying the amount with default currency ISO code. | ### Steps to reproduce Customer pays 100 EURO, default store currency is DKK = displaying customers valid order is worth 100 DKK, instead of 100 EURO - since stores can have many currencies i figured out it was best to convert the orders back to the default currency instead of guessing the most valid currency for each customer.

This PR was submitted to develop 21-02-2016 for fixing 1.6.1.X. Since then, Develop branch has been marked marked for 1.7 and this is why i submit it again as a new PR targeting 1.6.1.X - https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/5053 |

Create an order with a virtual product with a download and an order with a virtual product without a download, then check with (new Order($id_order))->isVirtual(); |

title: Fix ecotax rounded twice
issue_title: Fix ecotax rounded twice
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
If taxes are turned on on ecotax, ecotax used to be rounded twice. Once after fetching the DB value and the second time after multiplying it with the tax rate. Now it's only rounded after taxes. Example: If you want an ecotax of 10 (with 21% VAT), the ecotax in database is 8.264463 (because 8.264463 * 1.21 = 10). But without this fix, PrestaShop would round the ecotax DB value to 8.26, then multiply it 8.26 * 1.21 = 9.99 (wrong, one cent too little)

### Steps to reproduce
Test a product with an ecotax of 10 and tax rate of 21% on ecotax, before and after this patch

title: Payment method title extended to 255 characters
issue_title: Payment method title extended to 255 characters
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
32-char length is too short. DB schema describes this attribute as 255 char length. After fix now this is equal - DB and PHP code. It is not acceptable to trim to 32 chars, because this is used in email notifications and invoices. The buyer can't see whole title if it's more than 32 char length. E.g. if payment module name is „Credit card payment on products reception“ the buyer will see only „Credit card payment on products “.

### Steps to reproduce
Use payment method with title longer than 32 chars and see buyers email or PDF invoice.

title: Use shop email as sender for template order_customer_comment
issue_title: Use shop email as sender for template order_customer_comment
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
When a customer sends a comment from the order detail page, an email is sent to the shop's main email address, using the customer's email address as sender. This is a bad practice because the mail server of the shop is not authorized to send email using a customer's address. In many cases it wouldn't work anyway.

### Steps to reproduce
place an order from FO, and from the order detail page, send a comment to the shop. The email that is received from the backoffice is sent with the shop email as sender, and customer's email address as "reply-to".

title: Add missing option to bcc multiple addresses in Mail::send()
issue_title: Add missing option to bcc multiple addresses in Mail::send()
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
In commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/7157/commits/1cd93a88778d45bc0ff9dc23f258abc51b3e76e4 on develop the bcc array handling was added. I believe it's not just a new feature, but it's an actual bugfix, since on line 156 of this file a check is made on the bcc variable being an array, meaning that it is contemplated that it could very well be. Passing an array as `$bcc` (like with `$to` and `$to_name`) does not cause an the function to `dieOrLog`, it causes a `PHP Warning:  Illegal offset type in httpdocs/tools/swift/classes/Swift/Mime/SimpleMessage.php on line 404`. This is an inconsistency that needs to be addressed.

### Steps to reproduce
Call Mail::send() passing an array of email addresses as the `$bcc` parameter.

title: Add potential email error in order bulk action message failure.
issue_title: Add potential email error in order bulk action message failure.
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
When the order status changes, it can ask for a mail to be sent. On a single order update, the merchant is properly warned if the mail is not sent. For example (on 06-23-2016), ALL french Renault car maker employees accessing prestashop shops from their office can not place orders because they are detected as coming from country "EUROPE" with iso code "EU" and of course this is not a country... So they don't see prices or "add to cart" button even with those options selected : "Geolocation behavior for restricted countries : Visitors can see your catalog but cannot place an order."  &&  "Geolocation behavior for other countries : All features are available". see description and try with removing your country from the country list for example |

title: Fix conflict between two cart rules and a single product cart
issue_title: Fix conflict between two cart rules and a single product cart
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
The proposed solution resolves the specific case that combines two cart rules. One, to add a free product automatically. And the second one, to make a percentage discount. I've found a problem when the free product has no stock, and the cart has only one product. The FO gets the "Cart is empty" error. Now, the system checks if the free product is in the cart.

### Steps to reproduce
Generate two cart rules. one with a free product, and other with a percentage discount with code. The free product has to be a zero stock product. Then, add a product to customer's cart (it loads the free product cart rule, but it no adds to the cart beacuse don't have stock). Finally, try to add the second rule with the code on the order page. It generates the "Cart is empty error". The fix resolves this case

title: Use PS_GUEST_CHECKOUT_ENABLED ... only in checkout
issue_title: Use PS_GUEST_CHECKOUT_ENABLED ... only in checkout
issue_body:
### Describe the bug

While trying to find the actual fix for #8195, we discovered a configuration value created especially for the checkout process but used on the whole front office. `$guestAllowed` is an attribute of the class `FrontController`, stating if a guest is allowed to reach a controller.
This variable was giving access to all pages once the checkout process started as a guest, and @maximebiloe fixed this issue with #5608.

But it brought another issue ... The guest was then refused on all controllers requiring an authentication, even if the value of `$guestAllowed` was true (as described in http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/BOOM-2057).

### Steps to reproduce The checkout must be available for guests & logged customer. When you started the checkout process as a guest, try to reach `?controller=my-account`. You **must** have a login form.

title: Load id_shop routes when needed
issue_title: Load id_shop routes when needed
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
In a multistore context and with a module registering its own routes, this allow Link::getModuleLink to create a link pointing to a different store than the current shop. Eg: "View this module page in our other store : https://www.otherstore.com/customroute". Dispatcher::hasRoute curently doesn't load the other store routes, so Link::getModuleLink#L376 think it has no routes.

### Steps to reproduce
Enable multistore. Create a second store. Register a route with hookModuleRoutes. Display a link from one store to the other with $link->getModuleLink(..., $id_other_store, ...). Instead of having https://www.otherstore.com/customroute, it creates https://www.otherstore.com/module/modulename/route

title: Remove download limit (SQL manager CSV export)

issue_body:
### Describe the bug

### Steps to reproduce
You need a HUGE amount of data inyour DB. Then, in SQL Manager, create a requets that should generate a large amount of data. Click ont the Export button. You won't get your data in the exported file nor an error. Instead, you receive the requests list. This old commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/c85f23ba5a08832707ec143a996af45f1e39e71b added a filesize check against the upload_max_filesize server directive, but this seems irrelevant for a download (we didn't manage to understand why this condition was introduced). removing this condition solves the problem.

title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_body:
### Describe the bug When "Friendly URLs" are enabled together with Media Servers, there's a race condition where it will result in 404 for images either on the Media Server URL or the actual shop URL.
The issue is caused by wrong rewrite rules and the lack of a rewrite rule matching the shop domain. The bug isn't directly apparent on Apache 2.4.x servers because Apache silently "fixes" the rules (`RewriteCond` ending with `[OR]` without a following RewriteCond). The fix is to include the shop domain. ### Steps to reproduce Setup a shop, with "Friendly URL" enabled under "SEO & URLs", then go to Advanced Parameters -> Performance and add a Media Server such as cdn., ideally you' want this to actually be a CDN where the origin URL is configured to shop URL.
Expected result is that the image rewrite works on both the CDN/Media Server URL and shop URL at same time and the image is served as it should.

title: Collect all hooks for the debugger
issue_title: Collect all hooks for the debugger
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Hooks dispatched using `HookDispatcher` service are not collected by the debugger because the class `LegacyHookSubscriber` doesn't call them. Now they are dispatched, you can see the difference on Administration, Maintenance or Performance page when looking at "not called hooks" in Hooks section of the debugger toolbar.

### Steps to reproduce

title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_body:
### Describe the bug When "Friendly URLs" are enabled together with Media Servers, there's a race condition where it will result in 404 for images either on the Media Server URL or the actual shop URL.
The issue is caused by wrong rewrite rules and the lack of a rewrite rule matching the shop domain. The bug isn't directly apparent on Apache 2.4.x servers because Apache silently "fixes" the rules (`RewriteCond` ending with `[OR]` without a following RewriteCond). The fix is to include the shop domain. ### Steps to reproduce - Setup a shop
- Go to Advanced Parameters -> Performance and add a Media Server such as cdn., ideally you' want this to actually be a CDN where the origin URL is configured to shop URL.
- Go to "Shop Parameters" -> "Traffic & SEO", make sure "Friendly URL" is set to "Yes" and click "Save".

Expected result is that the image rewrite works on both the CDN/Media Server URL and shop URL at same time and the image is served as it should.

title: Fix issue with deleting a category with subcategories on Multistore

issue_body:
### Describe the bug
When deleting a category, it checks if there are multishop entries first before deleting images etc. However, when deleting a category with subcategories, the images and other associations of the subcategories will not get deleted because the top category gets deleted last, and the code checks multishop entries with $this instead of the variable of the category $cat that just got deleted. This bugfix solves that.

### Steps to reproduce
In the admin: Enable multishop and create an extra shop so you have at least two. Then put your context on "all shops". Then create a category under "Home". Then add a subcategory under the new category with an image. Then go to "Home" and delete the top category you just created. You will see the image of the subcategory is not deleted without this fix.

title: Remove deprecated functions
issue_title: Deprecated in PHP 7.2
issue_body:
Prestashop version: 1.7.4.4
PHP Version: 7.2.12

I got 3 advices in PHP logs:
1.  /controllers/front/CartController.php on line 128 - The each() function is deprecated.
2.  /src/PrestaShopBundle/Controller/Admin/AttributeController.php on line 175 - The each() function is deprecated. + Variable passed to each() is not an array or object
3.  /classes/Mail.php on line 872 - INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 is deprecated

For the third one, It seems now you are supposed to use INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46 instead. However, PHP seems to be still using INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_2003 as the default if none is specified. So, to avoid this one, you have to explicitly call with INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46 as parameter.
Something like: 
return $address[0].'@'.idn_to_ascii($address[1],0,INTL_IDNA_VARIANT_UTS46);

PHP docs:
1/2.   http://php.net/manual/en/function.each.php
3.   http://php.net/manual/en/function.idn-to-ascii.php

title: Installer: always clean test assets even if filesystem tests fail, an…
issue_title: Generated test directory at install step is not cleaned if github is down
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
When a PrestaShop 1.7.5+ is installed, the installer performs several checks to see whether it has been given the proper read&write rights. If these rights are available **and** the PrestaShop Zip archive is not the latest, it offers the user to download the latest Zip archive and install this one.

During these tests, fake files and folders are created. However [one of those tests](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L100) check that PrestaShop is able to download a file from github. If this test fails, the check processing stops there. However the fake files and folders are deleted at the end of the check processing: [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L109) and [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/tools/build/Library/InstallUnpacker/classes/ConfigurationValidator.php#L113). So if the check fails, the fake files and folders remain in the root folder of PrestaShop. They cause no harm, but they are useless.

This is not critical as this is a bonus feature that does not prevent the installation.

**TO DO**
- make sure fake files and folders are cleaned even if the check processing stops halfway
- do not rely on github to perform the "download" test (find a better test subject)

PrestaShop version: 1.7.5 at least

**Describe the bug**
When i tried to persist `PrestaShopBundle\Entity\AttributeGroupLang` entity, i had this exception 
```
Catchable Fatal Error: Object of class PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang could not be converted to string

```

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
```
$attributeGroupLang = new AttributeGroupLang();

```
    /**
     * @ORM\Id

     * @ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity="PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang")
     * @ORM\JoinColumn(name="id_lang", referencedColumnName="id_lang", nullable=false, onDelete="CASCADE")
     */
    private $lang;
```
After 
```
    /**
     * @ORM\Id
     * @ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity="PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang")
     * @ORM\JoinColumn(name="id_lang", referencedColumnName="id_lang", nullable=false, onDelete="CASCADE")

title: Fix bad annotation in AttributeGroupLang, AttributeLang and TabLang

issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
When i tried to persist `PrestaShopBundle\Entity\AttributeGroupLang` entity, i had this exception 
```
Catchable Fatal Error: Object of class PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang could not be converted to string

```

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
```
$attributeGroupLang = new AttributeGroupLang();
$attributeGroupLang->setName("Group Test");
$attributeGroupLang->setPublicName("Group Test Public Name");
$attributeGroupLang->setLang($lang);
$attributeGroupLang->setAttributeGroup($attributeGroup);

$em->persist($attributeGroupLang);
```

**Resolve this issue**
I resolved this issue by remove one line on the $lang attribute annotation in the AttributeGroupLang Entity

Before
```
    /**
     * @ORM\Id
     * @ORM\Column(name="id_lang", type="integer")
     * @ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity="PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang")
     * @ORM\JoinColumn(name="id_lang", referencedColumnName="id_lang", nullable=false, onDelete="CASCADE")
     */
    private $lang;
```
After 
```
    /**
     * @ORM\Id
     * @ORM\ManyToOne(targetEntity="PrestaShopBundle\Entity\Lang")
     * @ORM\JoinColumn(name="id_lang", referencedColumnName="id_lang", nullable=false, onDelete="CASCADE")
     */
    private $lang;
```


**Additionnal information**

title: Fix wrong cart calculation when using cart rule with virtual products
issue_title: Major bug with Virtual Products
issue_body:
Hello folks,

I think I found a major bug in the handling of Virtual Products in Prestashop 1.7.

First off some background:

A while ago, I asked for help with an issue I have about the total being incorrectly calculated when using discount vouchers:

https://www.prestashop.com/forums/topic/866094-total-doesnt-consider-voucher/

As you can see, no one bothered to give me an answer as of now. Because this issue keep costing me money I kept investigating. I set up a test server using the latest Prestashop build 1.7.4.2 and installed my theme to it, but other than that didn't bother to add any modules or even products. I found that with the default products the discount voucher was displayed correctly:

https://i.imgur.com/xHBmxKR.jpg

After a lot of testing I found the culprit! When I changed the product type to "Virtual Product" the discount voucher stopped being calculated correctly:

https://i.imgur.com/n7wdC7d.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/HuRWDFw.jpg

I considered that this might be an issue related to my custom theme, but even using "Classic" that comes with 1.7.4.2 the problem still remained.

I really hope you could look into this matter and fix it for the next update and it would be great if someone could provide me some clues how I can remedy the problem in the meantime. As I mentioned, I am actually missing out on sales right now, because people can't use their discount codes.

Cheers

title: Robots should not index search content
issue_title: Google Search Console can complain of `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` for search results pages
issue_body:
Google Search Console can complain of `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` for PrestaShop search results pages if it finds such pages outside of its crawl instructions.  While crawling search pages is disallowed by a properly created `robots.txt`, they can still be indexed if they are found through other means, which is quite easy to do.  For example, if one uses tags on the front end, these can appear as search links which will get indexed.

Proposed fix:

`controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php` should always include `<meta name="robots" content="noindex">` in the page output in case a search engine finds a link to a search results page. 
 1.7.5.0 diff output below:

```diff
diff --git a/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php b/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
index 400abc4d60..a31e9710d0 100644
--- a/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
+++ b/controllers/front/listing/SearchController.php
@@ -60,6 +60,15 @@ class SearchControllerCore extends ProductListingFrontController
         );
     }
 
+    public function getTemplateVarPage()
+    {
+        $page = parent::getTemplateVarPage();
+
+        $page['meta']['robots'] = 'noindex';
+
+        return $page;
+    }
+
     /**
      * Performs the search.
      */
```

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Include links to search results in your site, such as tags, like https://www.example.com/search?tag=headache on product, CMS or other pages.
1. Set up Google Search Console for https://www.example.com/
1. Wait for GSC to crawl and index your pages.
1. Observe the `Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt` warnings under Coverage for every encountered search link.

PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.0
PHP version: 7.0

This bug can be reproduces on clean install with demo goods.

Let we have some goods with total quantity 50 and simple carrier with some shipping cost.

The buyer creates an order and the shop calculates the shipping costs. For example he buys 20 qty. So in the BO one can see that in order qty 20 and 30 is available for the other buyers.

After that the buyer lets know that he wants to change quantyty and the new quantyty should be 30. Actually it could be any that would be equal or greater than quantity left.

The seller changes the quantuty to 30 and after that the shipping becomes free.

The problem is in the class Order method refreshShippingCost() line 2501. 

First in lines 2521-2524 fake cart gets zero quantyty and after that in lines 2526-2529 cart is sets with real quantity that the admin set.

If you have a look at the methor updateQty in the class Cart you can see that this method is invoked with default parametn operator = 'up'  so we get to the next if in the class Cart, line 1283 where the new quantity is been checked as the addon, not the new quantity. 
Since new quantity in not less that the quantity available for order the method updateQty returns false.

But this false result is not processed, see the class Order line 2528.

title: Solved problem with texture upload when attribute has hex color
issue_title: Uploading a texture to an attribute with a color code saved returns 404
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Uploading an image ("texture") to an attribute that have a color code saved will save the image value but remove the image which will return a 404 in the front office. Essentially it has saved the value for the attribute, but since the color code is set it removes the image. If we repeat the process, empty the color code, choose our image and then save, it now works.

**To Reproduce**

**[Part 1]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Set up an attribute for color
2. Add a color i.e. `#ffffff`
3. Set up some combinations using that attribute
4. Activate the attribute in the ps_facetedsearch module
5. Everything is working as expected

**[Part 2]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Edit that attribute and upload an image (keep the color code)
2. When you save you will not get any errors
3. Go back to and look at the ps_facetedsearch module
4. It will still be using the color code `#ffffff` but it will also be looking for the image since I _it's value_ seems to be stored in the database.
5. Check the browser console, it will be returning a 404 since it cant find the image. In my case it's looking for `.../img/co/8.jpg`.

**[Part 3]** Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Edit that same attribute
2. Notice that there is no image uploaded
3. Now empty the color value, select and image, and save.
4. Now everything works.

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.4.2

title: Unify algorithm for calculating average tax rate for products in a cart
issue_title: Unify algorithm for calculating average tax rate for products in a cart
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
There are currently two methods for calculating the average tax rate in a cart, `Cart::getTaxesAverageUsed()` and `$cart->getAverageProductsTaxRate()`. They used a different algorithm to calculate it, but it more or less ended up in "sum of all products without tax / sum of all taxes applied". This PR unifies the behavior and depreciates the static method.

### Steps to reproduce
Add many products to a cart, ideally with different tax rates, and with some reductions. In the order detail (FO), the reduction amount should be correct (or at least no different from before :trollface:)

title: Fix product not being added to cart after deleting product customisation
issue_title: The product doesn't get add to cart after deleting product customisation
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
The product doesn't get added to cart in the below situation.
Suppose a product is created with customization(with at least one required field) without any combinations. Now from the front end, we have added the customization and add the product to cart. In this case, the product will get added to cart. Now delete the customization fields from the back office and save the product, Now if you will try to add the product in the cart the product will not be added to cart. 

And now if you will try to duplicate this product from back office then the copy product will create with that product customization fields.  

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to catalog and click on New Product
2. Now add the product with customisation field in which there must be at least one required field
3. Set the basic configuration of the product as normal. No need to add combinations.
4. Now from front end save the custiomisation data and add the product to a cart.(The product will be added)
5. Now from back office delete the customisation from the product.
6. Now again try to add product in to cart (the Product will not added to cart)
7. Even if will try with other customer then also the product will not add to cart.

**Screenshots**
![addtocart](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/39614089/55610270-3493dc00-57a0-11e9-83c9-3c9d41ce35f1.png)


**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.1
PHP version: 7.0

Hello, That's my first issue open here and I hope to do everything right. Please forgive me if I do something wrong!

There is a problem that is driving me crazy: in prestashop 1.7.5.1 checkout, when I create a new address, if I click more than once on "Continue" button, i've got the error "no carriers for the selected address in the carrier's tab.

Here is how to reproduce the issue:

1- Place a product in the cart.
2- Go to checkout and register, or place the order as guest.

Plus, if you go back to your address, you can see that you have created a new address for every click you did in "Continue button" in address tab... that's bad!

The only way to fix this (via frontend) will be to empty and fill the cart again, but I really need a real fix for this, customers keep calling and I'm losing a lot of orders!

title: Remove useless and buggy identifier computation
issue_title: Getting issue on module admin controller's render list in Prestashop V1.7.6.1 with existing data
issue_body:
Hello,

Currently I am getting issue on my module's admin controller render list page in Prestashop V1.7.6.1 while my controller's render list has some data.
After research, I found that I am getting this issue because I am not using $this->identifier name similar to $this->table name on module's admin controller page.
For example, my table name is 'product_review' and here I am using primary key as 'id_review' So in this case, I will define $this->identifier = 'id_review' on module admin controller.

In previous prestashop version (below V1.7.6.1), I don't have any issue like this but on current prestashop V1.7.6.1, I am getting a error -
"Notice: Undefined index: id_product_review"

Check this screenshot -  https://prnt.sc/ozmiwc

In Prestashop V1.7.6.1, you are always getting entity like -   'id_' . $table_name
So have you restrict it in current version 1.7.6.1 because you didn't mention anything like this before.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a table in module i.e. table name 'product_review' and set primary key in this table as 'id_review'
2. Create a module's admin controller and set 
   $this->identifier = 'id_review'
   $this->table = 'product_review'

Now while you will add any data in your table and when you see render list of your admin controller then you will get issue like "Notice: Undefined index: id_product_review"
https://prnt.sc/ozmiwc

Here if I used my primary key as 'id_product_review' then I will get no error. So It looks like It is mandatory to set table primary key same table name.

Screenshots -

![error](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43534930/64022949-e4edec80-cb54-11e9-9f59-7938d96b0db3.png)


PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.1

<!--

**Describe the bug**
Using the sprintf function in non-native module templates causes an error depending on how the string is contructed.

Multiple bugs here.
1.75 templates using this function no longer work, 
Using this format

{l s='%s available' mod='roja45productrental' sprintf=['$model.availability]}

{l s='%qty% available' mod='roja45productrental' sprintf=['%qty%' => $model.availability]}

This string template contruction works:
{l s='%qty% available' mod='roja45productrental' sprintf=['%qty%' => $model.availability]}

This string template does not,

{l s='Collection After: %collect%' mod='roja45productrental' sprintf=['%collect%'=>$rental_product->collection_time]}

The position of the %xxx% is causing the error.  One is matched by the regex used in checkAndReplaceArgs in Translate.php, the other is not, so they follow different string replacement paths in the code.

Update the template to use

title: Fix modules translations files in theme erased by modules translations that are in modules folder
issue_title: Translations: Priority to apply module translations files in theme
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
When we translate modules in theme, translations is not applied because modules translations replace module translations are in theme.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Copy modules/marketplace/translations/fr.php in themes/classic/modules/marketplace/translations/fr.php
2. Edit translations
3. Translations are not applied

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.2
PHP version: 7.2

The problem is in classes/Translate.php, function getModuleTranslation, variable $filesByPriority that takes themes directory translations before translations of modules directory, so themes translations are replaced :
`$filesByPriority = array(
                // Translations in theme
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.5 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.4 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
            );`

We fix like this:

`$filesByPriority = array(
                // PrestaShop 1.5 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                // PrestaShop 1.4 translations
                _PS_MODULE_DIR_ . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
                // Translations in theme
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/translations/' . $iso . '.php',
                _PS_THEME_DIR_ . 'modules/' . $name . '/' . $iso . '.php',
            );`

What do you think about this fix?

title: Fix position problem on a fresh install
issue_title: Cannot update default category positions
issue_body: Category data has a field `position` that is not correctly initialized. It's initialized to 0, for all new categories, including default categories. Consequently if you try to modify categories positions from the Categories listing, the ajax request fails. The UI seems to show it worked, but actually the ajax request failed so if you refresh the page, you can see the categories positions are not modified. However if you perform 1 successfull positions update, for example moving the very last category created, then all category data items will be successfully fixed with `positions` data being correctly filled. **To Reproduce** 1. New fresh 1.7.6 PrestaShop install 2. In Back-Office, go on Catalog > Categories 3. Open your inspecter, on the "network" tab to see ajax requests 4. Try to drag-and-drop one category to modify its position. It seems to be working. 5. However you'll see in the inspector "network" tab that the ajax request failed and returned a HTTP 500 error page. See below the screenshot of the response. 6. Refresh the page, you can see category positions are not updated. PrestaShop version: 1.7.6 but I think the bug was there before, in all PS 1.7 versions. However it could not be seen. Now that Category page was migrated to Symfony in 1.7.6 the error is more obvious.

title: Fix display voucher conversion between currencies
issue_title: [BOOM-3688] Voucher value of a currency is converted twice in cart summary
issue_body:
> This issue has been migrated from the Forge. Read the [original ticket here](http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/BOOM-3688). - _**Reporter:**_ infisual - _**Created at:**_ Tue, 22 Aug 2017 19:02:07 +0200

I have two currencies in my store, default is US$ and other is SAR. When a customer completed a previous order in SAR currency, their loyalty points converted to a voucher with SAR value with correct amount converted from US$ to SAR. Now when the customer is placing a new order with currency in SAR then they apply the voucher in checkout, the amount deducted is correct in shopping cart; however the cart summary line for the voucher is displaying the voucher name and value multiplied again in conversion rate as if it is converted from US$ to SAR. title: Fix shop URL with port in header HOST
issue_title: Shop url with port
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**

When a server send a request with an host with port in HTTPS, Prestashop don't found the shop and send a redirection to HTTP url.

For instance when ATOS send a validation to the controller of Franfinance module (and probably Atos / atos3x), his HTTP header is : 

HOST: www.my-prestashop.tld:443

Then the Shop::initialize method try to find in shop URL $host with Tools::getHttpHost() witch return www.my-prestashop.tld:443 BUT in our shop_url we have only "www.my-prestashop.tld" without the port.

The tricky bug is that not all Atos server send host with port, we think that it depend of the payment server... But when a payment is manage by this servers, a payment is done but the order is not created an validated on the backoffice (redirection is not followed).



**Reproduce this bug**

curl -I -H "Host: www.my-prestashop.tld:443" https://www.my-prestashop.tld/

Response headers : 
HTTP/1.0 301 Moved Permanently
Date: Wed, 05 Jun 2019 14:18:30 GMT
Server: Apache
Location: http://www.my-prestashop.tld/
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Expires: Wed, 05 Jun 2019 14:18:30 GMT
Connection: close
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8


Correct response will be status: 200


**Suggested Pull Request**

We suggest to do this modification on the initialize shop method : 

$host = Tools::getHttpHost(false, false, true);

We can do a pull request.

The third parameter ignore the port. And will return www.my-prestashop.tld as expedted the shop will be found in the database and a status 200 will be return.

But for those witch have a specific port to access to its PrestaShop and configure a shop url with a port we introduce a bug...
So we try to find a fix and verify if a user can specify his own port, but we found that a user can configure as shop domain:
www.my-prestashop.tld:443foobar
It looks like a validation is missing because port 443foobar is not valid.

So we suggest to add a PrestaShop configuration (or equivalent) to ignore port or not all over the Prestashop platform (default value ignore = true). After that, getHttpHost third option can be replace by the new configuration.

Other heavy solution is to manage port on shop url table with a specific column to manage port.

What do you think about this ?

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.6.x and 1.7.x
PHP version: All

All calls on webhook or API (native or through a front Controller) using a server sending HOST with optional port (https://developer.mozilla.org/fr/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Host )

title: Check if Combination id is set before deleting Associations from database to prevent accidentally removing all products without attributes from all carts
issue_title: Combination::deleteAssociations deletes all cart products without attributes if id not set
issue_body:
From time to time the contents of most of the shopping carts in our store would be cleared without any apparent reason, affecting sales for a few days everytime it happened (probably from disgruntled customers abandoning the site), and breaking the functionality of some modules that didn't expect an order's cart to be empty.

After putting loggers around any function that might edit a cart's contents, it turned out that the Combination::deleteAssociations function doesn't check if the id is set before removing all cart products with the id_product_attribute corresponding to that id, which means that it will remove all products without combinations if called incorrectly, like this:

    $combination = new Combination();
    $combination->deleteAssociations();

In our case it turned out that the AdvancedPack5 module was the one incorrectly calling this function. However, the interface should not allow this incorrect usage as the effect is completely unintended and hard to debug. Instead a check needs to be made inside Combination::deleteAssociations and the queries that remove data should only be called if the id is set (i.e. does not evaluate to 0).

PrestaShop version: 1.5 (all), 1.6 (all), 1.7 (all) 
PHP version: N/A

title: Execute displayAdminLogin hook without shop context
issue_title: Error with hook displayAdminLogin
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

### BUG 1
**Describe the bug**
Hook `displayAdminLogin` is not in table `ps_hook`, so a module can not be hooked manually in this position unless you call `registerHook` function.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Install module dummymodule_v1.zip
[dummymodule_v1.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216911/dummymodule_v1.zip)
2. Go to "Design -> Positions -> Insert a module"
3. Can't be hooked to 'displayAdminLogin` because this position doesn't appear
4. Uninstall and remove module
5. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
[dummymodule_v2.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216910/dummymodule_v2.zip)
6. Go to "Design -> Positions"
7. Module is hooked to `displayAdminLogin`. You can unhook and hook module because now position is at `ps_hook` table.

**Hook `displayAdminLogin` should be inserted in `ps_hook` table in installation.**

**Additinnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6

### BUG 2
**Describe the bug**
Hook is linked with "multishop" and it shouldn't. It should be executed always, doesn't matter the shop context.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a multishop with 2 stores
2. Go to "Modules -> Catalog manager"
3. Select the store with ID 2 in the store selector
4. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
[dummymodule_v2.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/3216910/dummymodule_v2.zip)
5. Open BO login page in an Incognito tab
6. Hook `displayAdminLogin` is not executed
8. Uninstall module
9. Select the store with ID 1 in the store selector
10. Install module dummymodule_v2.zip
11. Reload the previous BO login page opened
12. Hook `displayAdminLogin` is executed (appears a string `Dummy module` under the login box)

Hook is only executed if you install module in "All shops" context or in Multistore ID 1, while in BO login page there is not a shop context yet. Query that retrieves module hooks for hook `displayAdminLogin` should not take into consideration shop context.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6

title: Upgrade SQL scripts can use DB_NAME, release creator regex fix, Tab.enable upgrade script fixed
issue_title: After upgrade to 177 the menu is empty
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
After upgrade to 177 the menu is empty, this is linked to the new `Tab::enabled` field that is used to hide menu links when modules are disabled.

**To Reproduce**
Perform an upgrade to 177: 
- you need to use the autoupgrade module and build a release archive for 177
- or you can try by upgrading via the command `php install-dev/upgrade/upgrade.php`

**Analysis**
The problem is that the field is added in the database but not correctly initialized.
A dedicated upgrade script does this job (`ps_1770_preset_tab_enabled`) however the upgrade scripts are called BEFORE the doctrine update is called, and since Tab is a Doctrine entity when the PHP upgrade is called the table has not been updated yet.

**Solution**
Perform the table update in the `1.7.7.0.sql` file before executing the PHP script.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: N/A
PHP version: N/A

title: Update id_order_state at the right place
issue_title: Amount paid is no longer validated when creating an order
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
When the amount paid sent in `validateOrder()` doesn't match with order total, order is created with state sent as a parameter (usually `Configuration::get('PS_OS_PAYMENT')`) instead of `Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR')` as in PS 1.7.5.2.

Since commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/57271b54b33503a31a103e95050f110f66c43dec#diff-0f162f4cf098397033f06b1cced01745, validation
```
// Amount paid by customer is not the right one -> Status = payment error	
// We don't use the following condition to avoid the float precision issues : http://www.php.net/manual/en/language.types.float.php	
// if ($order->total_paid != $order->total_paid_real)	
// We use number_format in order to compare two string	
if ($order_status->logable && number_format($cart_total_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_) != number_format($amount_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_)) {	
    $id_order_state = Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR');	
}
```

has been moved to `createOrderFromCart()`, so initial order state set in `validateOrder()` takes `$id_order_state` and is not changed to `Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR')`.

```
// Set the order status
$new_history = new OrderHistory();
$new_history->id_order = (int) $order->id;
$new_history->changeIdOrderState((int) $id_order_state, $order, true);
$new_history->addWithemail(true, $extra_vars);
```

**To Reproduce**
This can only be reproduced with an external payment method. Please contact me at info@idnovate.com or let me know your mail address so I can send you a module and credentials to test it.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.1

title: Prioritize customer search by id when saving an address
issue_title: Newly created addresses are saved with the wrong `id_customer`
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
Newly created addresses are saved with the wrong `id_customer`

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. The system must have at least one guest account and one non-guest account (the guest account must be created earlier)
2. Go to BackOffice -> Orders -> Add new order
3. Type the customer name or email we created earlyer (two accounts with the same email)
4. Select the latest account (with the highest id)
5. Create a new address for this customer -> "Add a new address"
6. After we save the address, we will not see it in the list and cannot use it. Since it is not there. 
After the research I found out that the address was assigned to a user with the same email but with a guest account. 
There are two inaccuracies here: 
 - the user's search is done first by his email and not by the id, and therefore. This is not true, that is why the address was assigned to the wrong user. 
 - I don't think there should be any guest accounts on this list at all. You can't create a guest order from BackOffice.

The easiest solution is to swap conditions if we can get an id_customer, then we don't need to search for a user by email (see at the screenshot)
![579b04c740](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1076017/67504135-88f59f00-f691-11e9-8faf-bdeb7440f7ca.jpg)

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.6.* - 1.7.*
PHP version: 5.6, 7.0, 7.1

The PR [https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/16074](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/16074)

title: Fix error SQL in getRecurseCategory method
issue_title: Error SQL in class CMSCategoryCore in the method getRecurseCategory
issue_body:
Hello,

I found a bug in CMSCategory class for the multisite mode Prestashop in last version 1.6.1.24.
You forgot an `id_shop` in SQL :
`$sql = 'SELECT c.id_cms, cl.meta_title, cl.link_rewrite
				FROM '._DB_PREFIX_.'cms c
				'.Shop::addSqlAssociation('cms', 'c').'
				JOIN '._DB_PREFIX_.'cms_lang cl ON c.id_cms = cl.id_cms
				WHERE id_cms_category = '.(int)$current.'
				AND cl.id_lang = '.(int)$id_lang.($active ? ' AND c.active = 1' : '').'
				GROUP BY c.id_cms
				ORDER BY c.position';`
Correction :  
`$sql = 'SELECT c.id_cms, cl.meta_title, cl.link_rewrite
				FROM '._DB_PREFIX_.'cms c
				'.Shop::addSqlAssociation('cms', 'c').'

title: Hide bad vouchers that should not be displayed to customers
issue_title: Customer can see all vouchers
issue_body:
EDIT: see reproductable scenario at https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/13002#issuecomment-476516323

EDIT2: this issue had too much history so we closed it and opened https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/15938 instead

**Description**
Customers can see all vouchers and cart rules you have created, even if they are generic.

You create a 'hidden' voucher with a 10% discount, to use it in some promotional campaigns, or to give them from a good will as a gift.

Now every customer that has registered can see this voucher in his account? 

**How to reproduce**
1. Create some voucher NOT limited to a specific customer. Create some vouchers limited to a specific customer.
2. Log-in to the customer's account in front office.

**Possible fix**
Commenting out $sql .= ' UNION (SELECT '.$sql_part1.' WHERE cr.`group_restriction` = 1 '.$sql_part2.')'; from CartRule.php seems to fix it, but I don't know what else it could break. Customer can then see only his vouchers, the group resctrictions work as they should.

title: Fix Cannot use object of type ParameterBag as array
issue_title: Cannot use object of type ParameterBag as array
issue_body:
I get exception when saving a product: Cannot use object of type ParameterBag as array.
```
[Tue Oct 01 14:45:05.873957 2019] [php7:error] [pid 15296] [client 172.19.0.2:47756] script '/var/www/html/admin/themes/new-theme/public/index.php' not found or unable to stat, referer: https://myshop.com/admin/index.php/sell/catalog/products/9018?_token=Tl8ItvVRfaL46AdjUjhk5F52XFRuJjsQPfPQPS7X9FY
[Tue Oct 01 14:45:15.704399 2019] [php7:error] [pid 19] [client 172.19.0.2:47768] PHP Fatal error:  Uncaught Symfony\\Component\\Debug\\Exception\\FatalThrowableError: Cannot use object of type Symfony\\Component\\HttpFoundation\\ParameterBag as array in /var/www/html/src/Adapter/Security/Admin.php:91
Stack trace:
#0 /var/www/html/vendor/symfony/symfony/src/Symfony/Component/EventDispatcher/EventDispatcher.php(212): PrestaShop\\PrestaShop\\Adapter\\Security\\Admin->onKernelRequest(Object(Symfony\\Component\\HttpKernel\\Event\\GetResponseEvent), 'kernel.request', Object(Symfony\\Component\\EventDispatcher\\ContainerAwareEventDispatcher))
#1 /var/www/html/vendor/symfony/symfony/src/Symfony/Component/EventDispatcher/EventDispatcher.php(44): Symfony\\Component\\EventDispatcher\\EventDispatcher->doDispatch(Array, 'kernel.request', Object(Symfony\\Component\\HttpKernel\\Event\\GetResponseEvent))
#2 /var/www/html/vendor/symfony/symfony/src/Symfony/Component/HttpKernel/HttpKernel.php(127): Symfony\\Component\\EventDispatcher\\EventDispatcher->dispatch('kernel.request', Object(Symfony\\Component\\HttpKernel\\Event\\GetResponseEvent))
#3 /var/www/h in /var/www/html/src/Adapter/Security/Admin.php on line 91, referer: https://myshop.com/admin/index.php/sell/catalog/products/9018?_token=Tl8ItvVRfaL46AdjUjhk5F52XFRuJjsQPfPQPS7X9FY
```

This was caused by a module trying to call a function that did not exist by mistake in the name. It was quite difficult for me to find the problem since the error log did not show anything about this.

**We can see that [$attributes prop of class Request](https://github.com/symfony/http-foundation/blob/1b189258972362a0c711e819e46c2a2b72153cc9/Request.php#L74) is of type ParameterBag, and [ParameterBag (latest and previous versions)](https://github.com/symfony/http-foundation/blob/master/ParameterBag.php) does not implement [arrayaccess](https://www.php.net/manual/es/class.arrayaccess.php)**

PR: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/15805

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.1
PHP version: 7.1.32

title: Make sure the keys used for translation are case sensitive
issue_title: Translation BO doesn't handle properly same translation with different cases
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

If you have in your translation two same strings but with a different case ("Order" and "order" for example), the BO / International / Translation will not be able to update the right string (it will pick up one of the key randomly).
It's because the key field stored in the database is not case sensitive (text instead of binary)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to BO / International / Translation
2. Choose a theme with several same strings, but with different cases (flowerio for example)
3. Try to translate it, usually you'll not see the modification because it will be applied to the wrong key

title: Fix guest to customer transformation issue
issue_title: Can't access FO admin after account was transfered guest to customer by the merchant
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

### Describe the bug

After transforming the Guest account to a Customer through the back office, the customer's merchant can't access his account since the password is randomly generated and never transferred to him.

### Expected behavior

After transforming the Guest account to a Customer through the back office, the customer's merchant should be able to access his account.

### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Command a product with a Guest account
2. Go to Customer view page or Order view page (1.7.6)
3. Click on "Transform guest account to customer account"
- It sends an email with email and generates a random password
4. A customer receives an email with only his email and no password

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43613217/75791915-8f95d080-5d6d-11ea-995e-5d478eea44fb.png)

So the customer can't access his account, except by resetting his password.

**Why?** 
The old template used to send in the password but for security reasons, we have hidden it on the new template design.

### Solution

Add a link to reset the password (the same from password_query template) with a new wording.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43613217/75792573-72153680-5d6e-11ea-9b8e-74764b892a11.png)

* PrestaShop version: N/A

title: Fix X-Forwarded-For not supported properly
issue_title: X-Forwarded-For not supported properly
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Given an installation of PrestaShop behind a reverse proxy / load balancer, I am seeing the following issues:

- When a user comes to the front office, the client IP is incorrectly evaluated as the IP address of the proxy/load balancer, and it ignores the X-Forwarded-For headers. This makes the "Visitors online" screen incorrect. (and likely other things)

- Maintenance Mode also ignores X-Forwarded-For headers. You can enable the Maintenance Mode, but you will not be able to add a IP address that will be able to see the front office.  I am assuming it evaluates all client addresses as the load balancer / proxy IP address. So if you put in the load balancer IP address, you will be able to see the front office, but the public will be able to as well. 

- When you click on the "Add My IP" button on the maintenance page, it ignores the  X-Forwarded-For headers and uses the IP address of the proxy / load balancer IP address instead. 

**To Reproduce**
see description. 

**Screenshots**
n/a

**Additionnal information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.1.5
PHP version: 7.2

- Changing the Tools.php's getRemoteAddr has no impact on any of the above issues. 
- We are using the  prestashop/prestashop:1.7-7.2-apache
- We put it behind a Nginx reverse proxy, like all the rest of our software, so that we are able to utilize the jwilder/docker-gen & jrcs/letsencrypt-nginx-proxy-companion docker images to enable SSL.

title: Cart object is undefined after refreshing the cart
issue_title: [BOOM-6253] Prestashop cart object is undefined after refresh
issue_body:
> This issue has been migrated from the Forge. Read the [original ticket here](http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/BOOM-6253). - _**Reporter:**_ DennisPW - _**Created at:**_ Wed, 15 Aug 2018 16:42:44 +0200

Using the prestashop.cart object in javascript together with various events we can create some very interesting and effective solutions.

However, this breaks on the cart page. Try the following snippet on a product page:

prestashop.on('updateCart', function(e) {
    console.log(prestashop.cart);
});

Now go to the cart page (with a few products added). Modify the quantity of any product. It will work the first time. Try it a second time, a third time. Now the prestashop.cart object will be `undefined`.

It's seems to somehow be related the the cart?ajax=1&action=refresh. If you are really quick and log the prestashop.cart constantly until the refresh happens you should be able to see that the information is updated and correct. As soon as the refresh happens the prestashop.cart object becomes undefined.

* How to reproduce the issue ? 1. Set up a simple function that logs out the prestashop.cart object on the "updateCart" event
2. Try adding a product from the product page
3. Go to the cart
4. Update a quantity, it will work the first time
5. Update a quantity, it will not work from now on

title: Don't loose group access on object model category save()
issue_title: Group access is lost when saving Category object model
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
Group access is lost when $category->save() is executed. Access group is always reinit to the 3 default groups.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to category admin page id_category X
2. Uncheck a group in group access or check and non default group (i.e. pro group).
3. Save this category in another place (controller or module code) with `$category = new Category(X; $category->save();`
4. See error : group access is lost and reinit to the 3 default groups.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.2
PHP version: 7

The bug is probably linked to the Category::cleanGroups() method that is launched by $category->save()
It's may be the same bug as https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/11289

issue_body: **Describe the bug** When creating an order from BO with product "Hummingbird printed sweater - size S", and choosing a status "shipped", the order is created BUT the order status is "payment error". This is true on `develop` branch (1.7.7.0) but I dont reproduce the bug with `1.7.6.x` branch so it seems to be a regression. **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go into BO on "Create an order" legacy page (not symfony) (URL `/admin-dev/index.php?controller=AdminOrders&id_order=8&vieworder`) 2. Choose customer "John Doe" 3. Add product "Hummingbird printed sweater - size S" to cart 4. Choose order status "shipped" 5. Click "create order" button 6. You should be redirected to "view an order" page for the order you just created and see a "payment error" warning: Some more notes: - adding the product "The best is yet to come" in the cart is fine so the issue does not happen with any product - other order statuses provide the same behavior, for example "payment accepted" **Additional information** PrestaShop version: develop PHP version: 7.2

title: Fix currency localization
issue_title: When I Install a new Language currency_lang values are not correctly set
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
During installation the `currency_lang` values are not correctly set.

**To Reproduce**
I already have two languages in my shop (French, English), and two currencies (Euro, Dollar). And I have customization on one of them (let's say Euro).
If I install a new Language the currency_lang for the new Language are correctly added in the database, but their value are incorrect. They don't match the default value of the new language (name, symbol and pattern are not correct). It seems the data from the default language are copied in the other languages instead of using the CLDR data.

![Capture d’écran 2019-12-04 à 16 33 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13801017/70156181-d3683380-16b3-11ea-825f-11c96845e710.png)

If I go and edit the incorrect currency the symbol and pattern are a bit better (they still use the transformation used but at least they respect the language specification).

![Capture d’écran 2019-12-04 à 16 36 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13801017/70156498-512c3f00-16b4-11ea-8248-23e1cfd80579.png)

And if i use the 'Reset default settings' (on official currencies) the custom values are reset and the names are also correct.


**Solution**
All these behavior are logical from the form point of view, the issue is not on the form but on the Language installation. When a Language/Localization pack is installed the currency_lang should have correct values:
 - name: translated name of the currency (or ISO code for unofficial currency)
 - symbol: symbol from CLDR for the installed language
 - pattern: empty

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.7
PHP version: N/A

title: Make rewrite pattern non greedy
issue_title: Make rewrite pattern non greedy
issue_body:
### Describe the bug Correct the default rewrite pattern to make it non greedy, so that others ids will be parsed wherever they are located in the route. A bug prevents to directly access with its direct URL a product combination that is not the default one. ### Steps to reproduce In the BO, in the SEO & URL page, in the field Product route enter "{manufacturer:/}{rewrite}{-:id_product_attribute}-{id}". Then in the FO go to the page of a product with a combination. With this patch, the id_product_attribute will be taken into account and the right combination shown, without you will go to the default combination, and if you debug you'll see that id_product_attribute was not retrieved.

You can also test with "{manufacturer:/}{rewrite}-{id}{-:id_product_attribute}", without the patch Prestashop will be confused and take the product_attribute_id as the product_id.

title: Can't export data more than filters limits
issue_title: Customers export from the BO - Wrong 50 limit
issue_body:
Hello,

When you use the "export" button of the customer grid from the Backoffice:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52968867/68471864-6b8f0c00-021f-11ea-8eea-c3d070c2414c.png)

The file is limited to 50 entries. It should extract all the Customers.

In the PrestaShopBundle\Controller\Admin\Sell\Customer\CustomerController::exportAction(CustomerFilters $filters)
There is no filter setting. So the default values of the Filter are the following:

    public static function getDefaults()
    {
        return [
            'limit' => 50,
            'offset' => 0,
            'orderBy' => 'date_add',
            'sortOrder' => 'DESC',
            'filters' => [],
        ];
    }

The issue can be handled adding: `$filters->set('limit', null);` at the top of the controller.

Best regards.

title: Prevent order controller from validating all guest addresses
issue_title: [Bug][Performance] Guest checkout validates all the guest addresses (thousands)
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
If you have a lot of guest checkouts, you'll have a lot of guest addresses (`ps_address.id_customer = 0`).

This causes a problem since, currently, the [checkout process validates all the customer's addresses](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/a51084f29cb87627ad57fde9d7932057c225b4e1/controllers/front/OrderController.php#L230-L233). In the case you're a guest, that means **all guest addresses** are validated.

If you have a lot (thousands or tens of thousands) of guest checkouts, all the addresses are being validated at any guest checkout, making it ever more slower.

**To Reproduce**
1. Create 10k guest fake customer addresses, `ps_address.id_customer = 0`
2. Try to do a new guest checkout
4. Observe seconds of delay in the `POST /order` request

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: latest, linked
PHP version: 7.2

issue_title: [EPIC] - Standardize breadcrumbs in Front-office
issue_body:
# Breadcrumbs in the Front-office

## Goal
The goal of this EPIC is to clarify the rule about breadcrumbs in PrestaShop Front-office and to adapt existing/add missing breadcrumbs according to it.

## Why
Several issues have been opened in the previous months about breadcrumbs. 
Some PRs on this topic have been submitted as well.

As of today, there is no clear rule defined about breadcrumbs in the FO. We need to define one and to implement it.

## Related issues

- [x] #29539

## Fixed 
### Related issues
- [x] #15440 - No breadcrumb on some important pages (like Stores, Sitemap, New Products, Best Sales, Suppliers, Cart...)
- [x] #16836 - Breadcrumb missing on my account page
- [x] #22416 - SEO-Problem: Breadcrumblist error
- [x] #23530 - Desactivated category still display in breadcrumbs
- [x] #26261

## Tasks

### Specs
- [Specs for breadcrumbs in Front-office ](https://github.com/PrestaShop/prestashop-specs/pull/88/files )

### Implementation 
Missing breadcrumbs to add:
- [ ] TBC

Existing breadcrumbs to remove:
- [ ] Breadcrumbs from CMS pages because they don't have more than 2 depths. 

Existing breadcrumbs to remove when user isn't logged in:
- [ ] /index.php?controller=Identity
- [ ] /index.php?controller=OrderHistory
- [ ] /index.php?controller=CreditSlip
- [ ] /index.php?controller=Addresses

Existing breadcrumbs to modify:
- [ ] /index.php?controller=Search (product page): 
Replace 'Home > Clothes > Women > Hummingbird t-shirt' 
by Home > Search results for hummingbird > Hummingbird printed t-shirt'

issue_title: Fatal error when trying to update an order through WS
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

Whenever we modify an order through web service, we get a fatal error:

```
Fatal error: Uncaught TypeError: Argument 1 passed to PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Localization\CLDR\ComputingPrecision::getPrecision() must be of the type integer, null given, called in /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/Context.php on line 465 and defined in /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/src/Core/Localization/CLDR/ComputingPrecision.php on line 41

TypeError: Argument 1 passed to PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Localization\CLDR\ComputingPrecision::getPrecision() must be of the type integer, null given, called in /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/Context.php on line 465 in /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/src/Core/Localization/CLDR/ComputingPrecision.php on line 41

Call Stack:
    0.0001     362936   1. {main}() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/webservice/dispatcher.php:0
    0.0524    2137272   2. WebserviceRequest->fetch() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/webservice/dispatcher.php:90
    0.1067    2620736   3. WebserviceRequest->executeEntityPut() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/webservice/WebserviceRequest.php:618
    0.1067    2620736   4. WebserviceRequest->saveEntityFromXml() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/webservice/WebserviceRequest.php:1495
    0.1088    2658792   5. Order->setWsCurrentState() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/webservice/WebserviceRequest.php:1647
    0.1089    2658792   6. Order->setCurrentState() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/order/Order.php:2455
    0.1102    2662048   7. OrderHistory->changeIdOrderState() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/order/Order.php:1684
    0.4145    3161264   8. Order->setInvoice() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/order/OrderHistory.php:371
    0.4158    3218504   9. Order->setInvoiceDetails() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/order/Order.php:1329
    0.4738    4679280  10. Context->getComputingPrecision() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/order/Order.php:1441
    0.4743    4680288  11. PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Localization\CLDR\ComputingPrecision->getPrecision() /Users/pBorowicz/repos/prestashop/classes/Context.php:465
```

Looks like `Context::currency` is not set when in the Web service context. So when we try and get the computing precision in `Context::getComputingPrecision()`, there's an error because currency is null.

That property is usually set by a controller AFAIK - since in WS there's no controller, that's likely the source of the problem.

This is  most likely a regression following the introduction of computing precision in this PR: #15084

#### Expected behavior

There should be no error.

#### Steps to Reproduce

On a clean shop, using [the WS library](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop-webservice-lib), execute the following script. Don't forget to replace the URL and api key with your own.

```php

// replace these with your own
$shopUrl = 'localshop.com';
$apiKey = 'X79PN91F233F4TS2AMZ59KIDTMRBDT9Q';

$ws = new PrestaShopWebservice(
    $shopUrl,
    $apiKey,
    true
);

$id = 5; //ID order Here

$xml = $ws->get(array('resource' => 'orders', 'id' => $id));

echo "BEFORE\n";
print_r($xml->asXML());

unset($xml->order->current_state);
//unset($xml->order->manufacturer_name);
//unset($xml->order->associations->order_features); //http://forge.prestashop.com/browse/PSCFI-6740
//unset($xml->order->quantity);
//unset($xml->order->associations);

$xml->order->current_state = 4; // status = shipped
$xml->order->shipping_number = 10; //tracking number

$opt = array(
    'putXml' => $xml->asXML(),
    'id' => $id,
    'resource' => 'orders',
);
$xml = $ws->edit($opt);

$xml = $ws->get(array('resource' => 'orders', 'id' => $id));

echo "AFTER\n";
print_r($xml->asXML());

title: Fix error when updating a used address with no DNI
issue_title: Fix error when updating a used address with no DNI
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

When the DNI required settings is turned on, existing used addresses with no DNI cannot be updated.

#### Expected behavior

When I update the missing DNI field of an address used in an order, I expect the used address to be updated silently (with the deleted flag set to 1) and I expect a new address to be created.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Ensure that the DNI to not required for the default country in International > Locations > Countries (no dni in the address format and Do you need a tax identification number? set to No)

3. Create an order and use the address created at step 2
4. Set the DNI to required for the country's address in International > Locations > Countries (add dni to the address format and set Do you need a tax identification number? to Yes)

title: Fix issue when there is a quantity discount on combination products
issue_title: Quantity discount based on parameter does not work
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When setting the "Quantity discount based on" parameter to "Products", it does not work

#### Expected behavior

When "Quantity discount based on" is set to "Products", if there is a cart rules or a specific price based on quantity, the discount should be applied as soon as we have in cart the required number of products, **even if there are different combinations in cart**.

When "Quantity discount based on" is set to "Combinations", if there is a cart rules or a specific price based on quantity, the discount should be applied only if there is the required number of products **in one combination**, and the discount will be applied only to this combination.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to Shop Parameters > Products Settings > Products (general)
2. Set "Quantity discounts based on" to "Products
3. Go to Catalog > Discounts > Catalog Price Rules
4. Create a cart rules with a reduction starting from quantity 3 (for example)
5. Go to FO, to a product with multiple combination available
6. Add 3 different combination to cart
7. Go to cart : There is no discount applied, it should be (since we have 3 combination from the same product)

**Screenshots**

https://drive.google.com/file/d/15q6jwbElhMi-PWSfen80WolJbRo5ZAH0/view?usp=sharing

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7
* PHP version: N/A

issue_title: Allow to choose a different language for order documents
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**

Hello, 
I am using Prestashop in association with Amazon marketplace module. 
So Amazon orders are created inside of Prestashop by this module every time an order is available. 
Client is created at the same time. 
I have checked with the developer for this module and the client language is also imported. 
Although if i go to the client i can't see his language. 
My issue is i am connecting to the BO using french language in order to print the shipping notes for the Amazon orders. but all of them are printed in french. Even the emails sent to the customers are always in french. Although customers are US based or Canadian based (english talking).
I even changed the default language for my store to English. 
What do i need to do to be able to print or send emails to customers in their language.
How can i check a customer language? (maybe a feature to show customer language on customer page?)

---
**Edited on October 23rd by Louise B.**

A. ✅ If as a customer you log to the system and view your invoices/delivery slip it definitely needs to be in the customers language.
--> this should use the language used by the customer in FO (works OK already)

**Specifications:** https://github.com/PrestaShop/prestashop-specs/pull/161/files

B. ➡️ But if the dispatcher is preparing the shipping and printing the invoice/delivery slip, then does it need to be in his language or in the customer language since it will be put in the colis to be shipped.
--> we could provide a new option to let the merchant decide if he wants to use customer language or employee language to download delivery slips and invoices when preparing orders. This option is to be added in Shop parameters > Order settings with the following wording:

**Label**: `Default language for order documents` in `Admin.Shopparameters.Feature`
**Tooltip**: `Select in what language you want to download invoices and delivery slips.` in `Admin.Shopparameters.Help`
**Dropdown selector**: `Customer language` / `Logistician language` in `Admin.Shopparameters.Feature`

By default, the customer language is selected.

**Specifications:** https://github.com/PrestaShop/prestashop-specs/pull/152/commits/464be4a0ee88da1bbc3659e487d8640ac0726ee7

C. ✅ Then if it is an accountancy person who is printing the invoices/delivery slips i can understand it is printed in the accountant's language.
--> this should use the language used by the employee in BO (works OK already)

**Specifications:** https://github.com/PrestaShop/prestashop-specs/pull/161/files

**Additionnal information**

title: Add missing entities in template inheritance.
issue_title: [Template inheritance] Prices-drop and best-sales
issue_body:
I noticed, some problems in template inheritance : some typos and missing params, that causes template inheritance not working as it should be.

The core checks locations in order, for specific entities :
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/7633be8294d90148d2bdfe3fd1c2d403e72ec91b/classes/Smarty/TemplateFinder.php#L37-L41

Unfortunately there is some typos here :

```diff
- private $productListSearchEntities = array('search', 'price-drop', 'best-sale');
+ private $productListSearchEntities = array('search', 'prices-drop', 'best-sales');
```

And as the param `'entity' => 'prices-drop'` is not passed
from `src/controllers/front/listing/PricesDropController.php` 
to `classes/smarty/TemplateFinder.php::getTemplateHierarchy()` 

it causes Prestashop to find **only** the exact-file : `catalog/listing/prices-drop` and not one of the following : 

1. `catalog/listing/prices-drop`
2. `catalog/listing/product-list`

If the 1st file don't exists, the "fallback template" (2) never loaded and a `[PrestaShopException] No template found for catalog/listing/prices-drop` is triggered.

I can make a PR if needed.

---
Prestashop 1.7.6.1 / PHP 7

https://prnt.sc/tryle8
It is showing correctly if tax rule applied to each product.
https://prnt.sc/trymai

The base price must exclude the product price in which tax rule is not applied.
Like this: https://prnt.sc/tryr6o

>Edit by Khouloud

title: Fixed duplication of Currencies after install/remove
issue_title: Creating a once deleted currency causes duplicate rows in database
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
When a currency is added in PrestaShop it is impossible to add it a second time, thus it prevents having duplicate
However, if you delete a currency and then add it again a new row is inserted and the former one is still present with its deleted column set to 1 (soft delete)
This means the database has duplicated rows, and that different orders with the same currency do not use the same one in database
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to Internationalisation > Localization > Currencies
2. Add a new currency (for example USD)
3. Go back to the currencies list and delete the newly created currency
4. Download the "added and deleted" curreny localization pack, for example, United Stets pack
5. A second row in the database is created

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/74455314-6a582580-4e85-11ea-8396-ef1becc49d80.png)


**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7, 1.7.7.x
PHP version: 7.1

PHP ini settings: `realpath_cache_size` and `realpath_cache_ttl` can only be changed via `php.ini` file or `httpd.conf` but not via `ini_set()`.
Because these options has mode "PHP_INI_SYSTEM"

[These options in php manual](https://www.php.net/manual/en/ini.core.php#ini.sect.performance)
> **Changeable** PHP_INI_SYSTEM

[More about PHP_INI_SYSTEM](https://www.php.net/manual/en/configuration.changes.modes.php)
> PHP_INI_SYSTEM Entry can be set in php.ini or httpd.conf

#### Expected behavior
N/A
#### Steps to Reproduce

```php
if (ini_set('realpath_cache_size', '1M') === false) {
    echo 'Cannot set "realpath_cache_size" ini option', PHP_EOL;
}
if (ini_set('realpath_cache_ttl', '300') === false) {
    echo 'Cannot set "realpath_cache_ttl" ini option';
}
```

**Screenshots**
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7098217/87776406-04067300-c828-11ea-8bd0-8e3da6bb4904.png)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7098217/87776410-0537a000-c828-11ea-84c2-8549484795e5.png)
