title: Prevent from loading old carts
issue_title: Prestashop loads old carts for logged in users
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

**Describe the bug**
When the option "Re-display cart at login" is turned on, and customer has some old abandoned cart, it will get loaded even if the customer also has some never ordered carts.

The cart should be loaded only if it's the last one from the customer's carts.

>Edit by Khouloud

**Steps to reproduce**
1. In the BO => Shop Parameters => Customer Settings => Disable "Re-display cart at login"
2. Go to the FO => login with your customer
3. Add some products to the cart
4. Sign out ( a new line is added to the BO => Shopping carts page)
5. Go to the FO => login with your customer
6. Add some products to the cart
7. Complete checkout
8. In the BO => Shop Parameters => Customer Settings => Enable "Re-display cart at login" again
9. Go to the FO => login with your customer
10. You will have old products in the cart.

#### Describe the bug

Due to this modification:
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/e59ebbddde684d7236b72aabbc2ce5bcb06d3364#diff-d5d273eeef7469e6cf4038eb2ee139ee12927a7709ea47f97d66e8b39da60178R587

Since PS 1.7.7.0, if you try to register a module in a hook, it's not registered in their alias. Instead, a new hook is created.

The problem is that the second parameter is set to false (before PS 1.7.7.0 it was empty, true by default).

#### Expected behavior

Module should be registered in the module or their alias.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install attached module

title: Fixed case where saving virtual product attachment is modifying product price if a specific price is set on the product
issue_title: Saving virtual product attachment is modifying product price if a specific price is set on the product
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

When using virtual products, retail price is getting modified during attachment save 
if there is a specific price set on the product.

#### Expected behavior

We expect the price remain the same , this is quite major issue as it messed up a lot of product prices in one of 
our customer shop.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create a "virtual product" with Retail Price Tax Inc  € 10.00
2. Add a specific price on the product (10% discount for ALL customers)
3. Go in "Virtual product" and add a file attachment, then click SAVE to confirm the attachment
4. Refresh the page and check the retail price again - It had been set to €9.00 (!)  - SAVING the attachment again will cause the price to get lowered again and again..

#### Additional information

Issue was debugged thanks to the help of M4 module creator.

The wrong line of the code is:

**$productAdapter->getProduct()** in **saveAction** method on **VirtualProductController** 
This method sets the product price using any specific price and later saves this wrong price.

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.9
* PHP version: 7.2

issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

This issue occurs only with a different currency than the default one.
A customer Group has a discount category for example 50% for the Art category
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/100217285-95db6680-2f13-11eb-9d5b-924206987557.png)
In the BO > Orders > Order page > when we Update a product(which is in the category discount) => the product's price is NOK.
If we generate the invoice => total incorrect

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to BO > International > Localization page
2. Import the United States pack
3. Go to the currencies page
4. Edit the $ currency with exchange = 10 (only to visualize the issue)
5. Go shop Parameters > Customer Settings > Groups Tab
6. Edit the customer Group, Add a discount 50% for the Art category
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/100223190-6f212e00-2f1b-11eb-909f-15f382806ea7.png)
7. Go to FO > Art category > Select `$` currency > Add the product `demo_18`to the cart
8. Continue checkout
9. Go to BO > Orders > Open last Order created
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/100223425-c4f5d600-2f1b-11eb-9980-d493d6e027c4.png)
10. EDit the quantity of the product ordered ( from 1 to 2 form example)
11. Save
12. See error => the product's total is NOK
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/100223533-ea82df80-2f1b-11eb-9ae7-12acabab18cf.png)
13. Change the status of the Order to Payment accepted
14. Download the invoice
15. See the error
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/100223794-42214b00-2f1c-11eb-8bf4-04995c56b57a.png)

1770finalbuild => NOK: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1IYCHdcMkUTZ_G_1K7QsWMywcziDSSc-x/view?usp=sharing

PS:1769 => ok: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dojva4t7oLJDFw1ZLxiV7RbfzmRCIZUy/view?usp=sharing


#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1770finalbuild1
* PHP version: 7.2

title: Save the newest Guest with updated datas
issue_title: Save the newest Guest with updated datas
issue_body:
### Describe the bug
Right now, with the module statsdata enable, while a guest authenticate, it's call this method. This method will firstly delete the row inside the guest table. After that, it's try to update the same row. Of course, it will never update anything as it's deleted before. The only solution is to add the ObjectModel, with the force_id set to true in order to keep the setted ID.

### Steps to reproduce
Install the statsdata module. Have a guest and authentificate it. See that row inside the guest table is deleted. With this PR, it will be not.

Since we split configuration forms into independent forms (#17819), id and name attributes in forms have changed, for example name attribute `form[general][enable_tos]` became `general[enable_tos]`, and its ID went from `form_general_enable_tos_0` to `general_enable_tos_0`. 

It is breaking some behaviors because sometimes we  have javascript relying on these attributes, also it is a breaking change for some modules that might rely on it too. This is among other things the cause of this issue: #21037

#### Expected behavior

There are two possibilities:

1/ We own the breaking change, write a doc about it, and we fix our javascript where it relies on former attributes.

2/ We find a way to make it so that the attributes remain as they were before, modifying Symfony's default naming. But we'd still have to fix other javascript pieces that relied on the new attributes.


#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: develop
* PHP version: not relevant

#### Describe the bug

https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/59f2ca0e1ec873195be0a3d879415c273b7d126a/classes/Product.php#L1129

This method forces the reset of the redirection options, so any configuration previously set in the product page will be erased/overridden. 6. Refresh the FO product page you should be redirect to the other selected product
7. Go the the BO product list, enable the product and the disable it again

11. Disable the product

title: Fix symfony cache clear
issue_title: Cache clear issue after optimization
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

The way PrestaShop clears Symfony cache has been modified by this PR https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/20942

Although it is more performant, it also doesn't clear everything we need because the container is not rebuilt.
Among the things that I fear might be involved:
- Symfony routing updated
- Doctrine entities management
- Module's services updated

At least the routing has been proved to be failing with the module `ps_linklist` the other two remain to be confirmed, `productcomments` which uses both seemed to be fine but it's hard to tell if it's because the container was fully rebuilt after its installation.

The `Cache clear` feature is also impacted since it relies on the same method `SymfonyCacheClearer::clear`

#### Expected behavior

The Symfony cache should be completely cleared to ensure the container is correctly rebuilt with up to date information. However we must keep in mind that these two issues are still correctly handled:
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/20852
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/11105

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior (bug for routing at least):

1. Go to Module Manager
2. Uninstall `ps_linklist`
3. Remove the cache manually: `rm -fR ./var/cache/*`
4. Go to Module Catalog
5. Refresh the page so that the menu is updated (this should be handled by MBO)
6. Click on Design > LinkWidget
7. See the error from screenshot, the url should be managed by Symfony router via the `_legacy_link` property but since the Router info were not updated it tries to access the legacy controller which does not exist any more

**Screenshots**

![Capture d’écran 2020-10-13 à 12 31 01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13801017/95851809-13c42380-0d53-11eb-9576-55bd161ef3f1.png)

#### Potential solution

We need to revert the command used back to `cache:clear` however it cause some issues because the memory limit was reached So one possibility is to dynamically force the memory_limit when we perform this command

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.8
* PHP version: N/A

title: Fix getting proper cover for image
issue_title: Issue with getting proper cover image, invalid cache key
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

Ok, first of all, this is really tricky error and it's kinda hard to prepare entire scenario for test.

I'm asking @jolelievre to take a look at this Issue as He was working on implementation of getting custom cover 😎 

When we have a module where we need to get list of products, and we want to make sure that cover image is displayed in relation to chosen product attribute, **and** same product is in our cart, or any other module **before** ours, our cover cannot be used.

#### Expected behavior

We need to be able to alter cover image, individually for every module/mechanism using `Product::getProductProperties`, without racing condition 👎 

#### Steps to Reproduce

Entire test scenario is related to `blockwishlist` module where I wanted to add proper cover image displayed, for chosen combination. You need to have module installed from this branch: 
https://github.com/PrestaShop/blockwishlist/tree/new-module

This is how module looks by default:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2137763/95639886-78088e00-0a9a-11eb-92e7-2bef570d448e.png)

I wanted to make it a bit more clear for people, to look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2137763/95639914-9078a880-0a9a-11eb-8579-6553288ac96a.png)

It's better to see chosen color, right? I've changed blockwishlist module, this is my file:
https://gist.github.com/kpodemski/7567a9ac574ff2c4a484f176e691a1ac

This is part of the code where I'm forcing `Product::getProductProperties` to display my cover instead of default one.
https://gist.github.com/kpodemski/7567a9ac574ff2c4a484f176e691a1ac#file-wishlistproductsearchprovider-php-L177

This is code where it's happening:
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/classes/Product.php#L5569

Logic is simple, if we don't provide `cover_image_id`, PrestaShop will handle this and display cover selected by merchant (without taking care of combination images etc.)

Now, this is how wishlist product list is looking after my modification:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2137763/95639914-9078a880-0a9a-11eb-8579-6553288ac96a.png)

This is same product but with different combinations, now, lets add this product to cart, refresh... and...

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2137763/95640164-ba7e9a80-0a9b-11eb-9513-f32e0d873372.png)

Complete mess, why? Because by default cover is black, and cached version from `Product::getProductProperties` is getting only first needed result from the page, `Cart` is first, so we're looking at black cover instead of our selected one.

PR to follow 😎 

**Screenshots**

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain your problem.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7
* PHP version: N/A

title: Possibility to check if we're in product quick view mode
issue_title: Regression related to quick view and hookDisplayProductAdditionalInfo
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug Because of this PR: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/15297 Module developers are unable to determine if product is refreshed in quick view context or not. #### Expected behavior We should be able to check wether module is displayed in quick view or not, previously it was possible. #### Steps to Reproduce Steps to reproduce the "good" behavior from 1.7.6: 1. Make sure you have `ps_sharebuttons` module installed and enabled 2. Edit `/themes/classic/modules/ps_sharebuttons/views/templates/hook/ps_sharebuttons.tpl` 3. Put at the beginning of the block: `
{$smarty.post|@print_r}
` 4. Go to homepage 5. Enable quick view on some product with attributes 6. See that there's an array: ``` [action] => quickview [id_product] => 1 [id_product_attribute] => 1 ``` 7. change attribute, see that we still have an access to `[action] => quickview` Of course this is wrong that `id_product_attribute` is not updated etc. and at the end #15297 is helping with that **but**, let's check this on 1.7.7 now: 1. Make sure you have `ps_sharebuttons` module installed and enabled 2. Edit `/themes/classic/modules/ps_sharebuttons/views/templates/hook/ps_sharebuttons.tpl` 3. Put at the beginning of the block: `
{$smarty.post|@print_r}
` 4. Go to homepage 5. Enable quick view on some product with attributes 6. See that there's an array: ``` [action] => quickview [id_product] => 1 [id_product_attribute] => 1 ``` 7. **Now the important part**, change attribute, new array: ``` [ajax] => 1 [action] => refresh [quantity_wanted] => 1 ``` As you can see `action` is different than in 1.7.6, because of this I can't as a module developer check from `.tpl` if module is in quick view or not, because of this some of modules I work with doesn't work. PR to follow. #### Additional information * PrestaShop version: 1.7.7 * PHP version: N/A

title: Update to check Language association to the current store
issue_title: Error  with the context->language in multistore context
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

There is an error in selecting the correct language when using a multishop and different languages for each store. 

 For example, let's assume that we have two shops (multistore) in the same domain with a virtual URL for each one:

SHOPA is using www.teststore.com/shopa with only English as a main and default language.
SHOPB is using www.teststore.com/shopb with only Spanish as a main and default language. 

English is only associated to ShopA and Spanish is only associated to ShopB. 

Both stores are in the same group. 

If you go to SHOPB you can see all the information in spanish, but if you access SHOPA then the selected language from the cookie is Spanish wich is not associated to SHOPA. 

This error is created in the config.inc.php file 

#### Expected behavior

When changing shops the id_lang from the cookie should be checked and validated in the config.inc.php before start loading the translations. 

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create two shops in the same group, assign the same domain and a virtual url for each one.
2. Assign one language to SHOP A and other Language to SHOPB , different languages for both and only associated one language per store. 
3. Go to SHOPA and then go to SHOPB, the language in SHOPB is the language set in SHOPA (To validate this just dump($context->language) in config.inc.php around line 200).


* PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.1 (But still happening up to 1.7.6.5)
* PHP version: 7.2.27

issue_title: [Options tab] - Suppliers 5/5
issue_body:
As a merchant, I want to be able to manage the options of my products.

**Suppliers**: This part is displayed only if you have created and enabled at least one supplier. Indicating the product's supplier is not really important for customers, but it may turn out to be an essential part for the merchant’s internal management, not least when managing stock: the merchant simply needs to know who he bought the product from.
  * **Information message about suppliers**: “This interface allows you to specify the suppliers of the current product and its combinations if any. You can specify supplier references according to previously associated suppliers.” Click on read more link to display the following information: “When using the advanced stock management tool \(see Shop Parameters > Products settings\), the values you define \(price, references\) will be used in supply orders.”
  * **Choose the suppliers associated with this product**: All enabled suppliers are displayed with a checkbox before their names. If it’s checked, the product is associated to the supplier and displayed on the supplier page in front-office.
  * **Default supplier**: When you check a supplier, a radio button allowing to choose the default supplier appears. When there is only one supplier checked, the default supplier radio button is automatically checked. The first supplier checked is the default supplier. When there are many suppliers checked, you can change the default supplier.
  * **Supplier reference\(s\)**: This part is displayed only if you have associated at least one supplier to the product. The supplier's section also features a table that enables you to set the precise reference and unit price/currency for each product combination, per supplier. If the product has more than one supplier, the table will display each supplier one after the other.
  * **Information message about supplier reference\(s\)**: “You can specify product reference\(s\) for each associated supplier. Click "Save" after changing selected suppliers to display the associated product references.”
  * **Table of suppliers**:
    * **The product name**: Display the product name
    * **Supplier reference**: Field to specify the product reference for each supplier.

---

'Disassociate one supplier should delete only this supplier's data and not the other suppliers' data. Same for the deletion of a supplier in Catalog > Brands & Suppliers > Suppliers.' (https://github.com/PrestaShop/prestashop-specs/pull/132)

title: Fix the combination's disappearance from Cart when it's updated by WS
issue_title: Webservice: Combination disappear from carts on update
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When you read a combination via webservice and update it without any changes (same dto), if this combination is in any Customer cart, it disappear from cart (always). The combination is updated right. Any error is trigged by webservice. Any message displayed to the customer.

#### Expected behavior

The combination must be remain in the cart (respecting business rules and domain logics)

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1) Create a product
2) Create some combinations
3) Insert a combination in the cart on public side
4) Read this combination with web service 
5) Update read combination from web service (same read dto unchanged)
6) This combination left the cart (ALWAYS)

---

1. FO> add the **Hummingbird cushion** with **Black** color in the cart
2. In Postman, choose the **PUT** method
3. For the **request URL**, paste this link http://your_site/api/combinations/27 (need to change your_site by yours)
4. Click on the **Authorization** tab
5. Choose **Basic Auth** and paste the WS key in the **Username** and **password**, Save

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23308427/106504612-776f8980-64c7-11eb-9650-896fd50502f2.png)

6. Click on **Body** tab and paste this structure

```
<prestashop>
    <combination>
    	<id>27</id>
        <id_product>11</id_product>
        <quantity>300</quantity>
        <reference>17</reference>
        <quantity>300</quantity>
        <minimal_quantity>1</minimal_quantity>
        <associations>
            <product_option_values nodeType="product_option_value" api="product_option_values">
                <product_option_value>
                    <id>11</id>
                </product_option_value>
            </product_option_values>
        </associations>
    </combination>
</prestashop>
```

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23308427/106504363-2364a500-64c7-11eb-9f96-b8cb04a1edfe.png)

7. Click on **Send** button
8. Check the FO and refresh
9. See error => the cart has been emptied

* PHP version: 7.2.34

title: Allow extra fields in product combinations
issue_title: Add custom module fields in ProductCombination form
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

For a client, I wanted to display additional fields into the Product and ProductCombination forms.
For the product one, no problem using the `displayAdminProductsExtra` and `actionProductUpdate` hooks.
For the combination one, I encountered issues dealing with form submission after using `displayAdminProductsCombinationBottom` hook. Symfony complained about extra fields submitted and thrown an exception. Thus the `actionProductAttributeUpdate` was never called.

#### Expected behavior

Allowing extra fields in the ProductCombination form to allow modules to alter the form.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create a module.
2. Use the `displayAdminProductsCombinationBottom` hook inside.
3. Use a template and add a field like `<input type="text" class="form-control" name="combination_{{ id_product_attribute }}[attribute_xyz]" id="combination_{{ id_product_attribute }}_attribute_xyz" value="{{ attribute_xyz }}" />`
4. Edit a product with a combination, edit the combination, save it.
5. See the error.

**Screenshots**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/690629/104320066-d127f980-54af-11eb-8444-c274054bb252.png)

With the fix

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/690629/104320183-00d70180-54b0-11eb-9540-44997c24a1b1.png)

title: Fix help text not displayed in form_row
issue_title: Form Type help and popover tooltip not display properly
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

If you want to create a Form type with a tooltip or help. It can't be display simulaneous. You need to split the form_row


#### Expected behavior

If you declare a 
```php
$builder
	->add('CHECKBOFORM_YESANDNO', YesAndNoChoiceType::class, [
		'label' => 'Yes and No',
		'help' => 'Help me I\'m famous !',
		'label_attr' => [
			'popover' => 'Tooltip me I\'m famous !',
		],
	]);
```
It should display : 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4932192/83625717-b1813800-a594-11ea-9040-c7b1cd2cb743.png)


#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install PS 1.7.7 and [sample module](https://github.com/202ecommerce/checkboform)

2. If you define in your twig template, _popover tooltip_ will not be displayed

```twig
{% block form_rest %}
	{{ form_rest(settings) }}
{% endblock %}
```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4932192/83626053-34a28e00-a595-11ea-8dc4-27f064b05d84.png)

3. If you define a specific form_row in your twig template, _help_ will not be displayed

```twig
{{ form_row(settings.CHECKBOFORM_YESANDNO) }}
{% block form_rest %}
	{{ form_rest(settings) }}
```

title: Fix maximum compatible PHP version and error wordings
issue_title: Maximum PHP compatible version is confusing
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When you try to install PrestaShop using PHP 8, you will get an error message saying that your version is not supported, like this:

![Screencap](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/86795974-6617e900-c06e-11ea-8fd6-9f077eb40197.png)

The message has been updated since to account for compatibility with PHP 7.4 and it now reads: 

> PrestaShop requires at most PHP 7.5.0 or fewer versions. To install PrestaShop 1.7.8.0 you need to downgrade your version of PHP.

There are a couple problems with this wording:

1. There is no, and probably never will be, a PHP version 7.5
2. It misleads the reader into thinking that PrestaShop will work with PHP 7.5
3. There is a mistake in the wording: "or fewer versions". The right word is "lower".

#### Expected behavior

1. The message should be replaced by this one: 
    > "Your server is running PHP {CURRENT_VERSION}, but PrestaShop requires PHP 7.4 or lower. To install PrestaShop 1.7.8.0 you need to downgrade your PHP version." 
    
    _Note how the maximum version does not include patch releases._
2. I should be able to install PrestaShop with any patch version of PHP 7.4.x

I suggest configuring it as follows:

```php
define('_PS_INSTALL_MAXIMUM_PHP_VERSION_ID_', 70499);
define('_PS_INSTALL_MAXIMUM_PHP_VERSION_', '7.4');
```

title: Use defined() with quotes, they're not optional.
issue_title: Improper use of `defined` to check for a constant
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

`defined(_CONSTANT_)` is wrong. Quotes are not optional.

    var_dump(defined('_CONSTANT_'));  // false
    var_dump(defined(_CONSTANT_));  // false
    define('_CONSTANT_', true);
    var_dump(defined('_CONSTANT_'));  // true
    var_dump(defined(_CONSTANT_));  // false (INCORRECT)
    // Warning:  Use of undefined constant _CONSTANT_ - assumed '_CONSTANT_' (this will throw an Error in a future version of PHP)

#### Expected behavior

The PHP function `defined()` should always be used with quotes when testing for a literal constant.

#### Additional information

This error occurs 6 times in `Prestashop/Prestashop`, and once in `Prestashop/pagesnotfound`.
Two occurrences in `Prestashop/Prestashop` fixed in #24985
Four occurrences in `Prestashop/Prestashop` fixed in #25003 
Occurrence in `Prestashop/pagesnotfound` fixed in https://github.com/PrestaShop/pagesnotfound/pull/15#issue-672656650

This issue occurs when we have multi-invoice (more than 2 invoices created).
When we try to add the same product to a specific invoice, a modal is displayed.
It shouldn't, we need to have only alert `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create an order
2. Go to BO > Orders > View last order created with `Product1`
3. Generate an invoice
4. Add the same product `Product1` with creating a new invoice
5. Add the same product to any invoice with changing the product price 
6. See error: a modal `Edit the price` is displayed => it shouldn't, we should have `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

**Another case**

1. Create an order
2. Go to BO > Orders > View last order created with `Product1`
3. Generate an invoice
4. Add the same product `Product1` with creating a new invoice
5. Edit the product price and confirm the update
5. Add the same product to any invoice without changing the product price 
6. See error: a modal `Edit the price` is displayed => it shouldn't, we should have `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/119973446-c7f97e00-bfb3-11eb-9684-1637ad766e4c.png)

With PS176 => we can add the same product without any alert

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 177x, 178x
* PHP version: 7.2

#### Describe the bug

Related to this issue: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/23401
In the BO > Orders > Order list page > in the preview order section: when we click on the tracking URL, the URL is NOK.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1.Go to BO > Shipping > Carriers page
2. Edit a carrier (My carrier for example) and add a Tracking URL `http://example.com/track.php?num=@`
3. Create an order by selecting `My carrier` as a shipping method
4. Go to BO > Orders > last order created
5. In the carrier Tab > EDit the carrier and add a tracking number = 12 for example
6. Go to BO > Orders > Orders list page > Preview last order

issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When the multistore option is activated and at least two shops have been created, a new panel is displayed at the bottom of module configuration pages, containing a checkbox labeled "Activate module for this shop context". Checking/unchecking this checkbox is supposed to enable/disable the current module for the current shop context.

This does not currently work. Accessing a module's configuration page from a context where it is disabled and clicking  the checkbox to activate it just reloads the page, leaving the module deactivated and reseting the checkbox to its unchecked state.

#### Expected behavior

Checking the box should systematically enable the module for the current context, and unchecking it should disable it.

#### Steps to Reproduce

1. Activate the multistore feature if disabled, in Parameters > General > Enable Multistore
2. Access Multistore in Advanced Parameters and create one if only one exists
3. Install a module that has a configuration page, like the Contact form module for example
4. Access its configuration page from the context of a shop where it's enabled, and then swap to the new shop
5. It will show as disabled by default. Check the "Activate module for this shop context" box.
6. The page reloads showing the checkbox unchecked, and the module is still disabled in this context

title: Fix upgrade from 1.6.1.24 to 1.7.8.x
issue_title: Fix upgrade from 1.6.1.24 to 1.7.8.x
issue_body:
### Describe the bug There were a few changes that prevented the upgrade to complete:
  • `Language::getCountry()` required a string but null could be passed. Using `Language->getLocale()` instead of `Language->locale` solve this issue
  • The `Tab` structure changed and 2 new fields (`wording` & `wording_domain`) have been added but are not present yet when migrating the tab in the 1.7.0.0.sql script file. Unsetting those 2 keys from the data array solve this issue
  • `$this->translator->getSourceString()` could return an `int` in some cases, breaking the return type and leading to an exception. Casting the returned value to `string` solve the issue
### Steps to reproduce Try to migrate from 1.6.1.24 to a build of 1.7.8.x, it should work

title: When saving an image as a square png, add always a transparent border
issue_title: Using `png_all` option in BO, all images should have transparent background in FO
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

This is somewhere between a bug and an improvement.

When choosing `Use PNG for all images` (`png_all`) as Image format (in menu *Design - Image Settings*), the background is transparent when the original image is in png format and white otherwise.

#### Steps to reproduce
1. Use these two images. [test_images.zip] One is in png format, and one is in jpg format (https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/6279138/test_images.zip)
2. In menu *Improve - Design - Image Settings*, under *Image generation options*
    for *Image format* choose *Use PNG for all images*
    for *Generate images based on one side of the source image* choose *Automatic (longest size)*
3. Upload both images into a product.
4. Go to the image folder and inspect the generated images.

#### Observed behavior
The resulting resized images are different. Even though they are both saved as png, one is transparent and the other is not (the added border is white, when the original file was in jpg format, and it is transparent when the original was in png format.
a) The original was jpg. The result is a png with a white border (`cart_default` size).
![62673-cart_default](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/115393433-faa89d80-a1e1-11eb-8fbd-df532c7537fe.jpg)
b) The original was png. The result is a png with a transparent border (`cart_default` size).
![83771-cart_default](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/115393505-114ef480-a1e2-11eb-874d-ac3aa101ac25.jpg)
Change github.com to dark mode to see the difference immediately. Or see below https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/23920#issuecomment-822564239 for a screenshot.

#### Expected behavior
I expect both images to be visually the same, with a transparent border. The output format is png for both, because we 
have choosen *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), therefore both should have a transparent border.

This would allow for more flexibility for the design of the templates. Also it makes more sense to always make use of the advantages the png format offers when we choose *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), and not make the use of transparency dependent on the source format.

#### Backwards compatibility

This should be backwards compatible, since images whose original format is png are already transparent.
It removes the constraint that a template must give a white background to the image in order to hide the difference between a jpg and a png image.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.6.1.1 and 1.7.7.3
* PHP version: any

issue_title: Accidentally change product order quantity when swipe on touchspin
issue_body:
When using Prestashop on smartphone/tablet or any other device with touchscreen.
If while you're on cart page you scroll the page swiping finger on the touchspin "+" and "-" the product quantity will change, like if you clicked on it.
This can cause to accidentally change product quantity.

I think that "+" and "-" button should increase (or decrease) product quantity only when you click on it, and not just swiping on it.
In particular on smarphone, because the position it's very close to where you normally swipe with thumb when using it with one hand.

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to front office using a device with touchscreen display
2. Add anything to the cart
3. Open cart
4. scroll up and down swiping finger on the touchspin "+" and "-"

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.3
* PHP version: 7.3

title: Display multishop header for translations page and lock it to all shops context
issue_title: No Multistore header in the translation BO component
issue_body:
This bug seems to be related to [Refactoring of Translation storage component](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/19242) project and [Multishop 1.7.8](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/19304) project

## Issue description by @Robin-Fischer-PS https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/23696#issuecomment-812523672

In Multistore, I have no header in the translation component (no Legacy or Migrated header).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/55688534/113417574-f8fa6f80-93c3-11eb-843b-ae21e212c015.png)

Furthermore, in 1.7.7 (and in 1.7.8 with and without this PR), the context the user is seems to have no impact : When I edit a translation in Context 1, if I switch to Context 2, the translation will also be modified.

Maybe this page should be forced in All Shops context ?

**Answer from @marionf **: Yes, it will be better to force the context to "all shops" :)

title: Fixed API inconsistent return format of JSON
issue_title: API /orders endpoint inconsistent return format of JSON
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

Endpoint /orders have 2 different formats of json returned based on quantity of orders which will be fetched.

#### Expected behavior

I expect it to returns orders in same format, or different HTTP status code for empty list. The first one is a preffered

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Call api /orders?output_format=JSON&display=full
2. It will be in format
`{
    "orders": [
        {
        ...
}
]}`
3. Call api /orders?output_format=JSON&display=full&limit=100000,20 (or other limit number which will return empty list)
4. Response will be in format
`[]`

That format is wrong, if you look at xml response you can see that it always returns format
```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<prestashop xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
    <orders></orders>
</prestashop>
```

Preffered format of json for empty list of orders should be like this:
```
{
    "orders": []
}
```
Now you clearly see that base object is an Object not a List/Array of objects and that orders are empty

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38075691/104166784-95cbf300-53fb-11eb-99bc-47fb6a4ca500.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38075691/104166799-9c5a6a80-53fb-11eb-8b33-f8faaa3475b5.png)

title: Fix warning on the Customer Threads page
issue_title: Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable
issue_body:
#### Description

When saving the imap settings on the backend customer service page the following error is shown.

`Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable`

LINE 1014 = `$errors = imap_errors()` 
this returns a boolean when there are no errors.

LINE 1021 = `if (count($errors) && is_array($errors) {` _[current code]_
This is because the IF-statement which checks the $errors array is in the wrong order.
If nothing is returned from imap_errors() then $errors becomes a boolean which isn't countable

Changing LINE 1021 fixes the issue 
`if (is_array($errors) && count($errors))  {` _[fix code]_
 -> switching the 2 options of the IF-statement

#### Steps to Reproduce

title: Fix actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate call location
issue_title: hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate not working correctly
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

There is a problem with the hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate.
In the following code, the hook is never called because I have an TransistEmailSendingException but the trackingNumber is updated. The hook should be before email exception.

```
if (!empty($trackingNumber) && $oldTrackingNumber != $trackingNumber) {
            if (!$orderCarrier->sendInTransitEmail($order)) {
                throw new TransistEmailSendingException('An error occurred while sending an email to the customer.');
            }
            $customer = new Customer((int) $order->id_customer);
            $carrier = new Carrier((int) $order->id_carrier, (int) $order->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId());
            Hook::exec('actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate', [
                'order' => $order,
                'customer' => $customer,
                'carrier' => $carrier,
            ], null, false, true, false, $order->id_shop);
        }
```

#### Expected behavior

If there is an error on updating the tracking number should not be updated. But in our case it is updated.
The hook need to be fire before the emailing error.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install the module ps_qualityassurance
2. Create an hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate
3. Disable emailing on your server or local environnement
4. The hook is not called

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.5

issue_body:

If we search for testproduct1; testproduct2; testproduct3 the result is 'NO PRODUCTS FOUND'  but it SHOULD  give us the 3 products

If i replace the find() function on Prestashop 1.7.7.5 with the one from 1.7.6.8 it all works as expected and fine

title: Fix blocking add to cart button
issue_title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"


#### Expected behavior

The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js


#### Steps to Reproduce

1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

3.After the popup is closed, all other buttons will be disabled.


**Screenshots**
Before clicking the "Add to cart" button:
https://prnt.sc/18a24cm

after closing the popup, all buttons are disabled:
https://prnt.sc/18a1zux

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.8.0

issue_title: Catalog Price Rule not working with multi shop when on a specific category
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When creating a catalog specific price rule **_using conditions_**, the rule is not working as expected if you choosed the second shop on a multi shop installation of prestashop.

#### Expected behavior

The conditions should target the selected shop.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Configure a multi shop with 2 shops
2. Create a category available only in the second shop
3. Create a product available only in the second shop (shop id 2)
4. Create a catalog specific price rule (`/admin/index.php?controller=AdminSpecificPriceRule`) and select the second shop in the shop dropdown
5. Add a condition to target the category of the product.
6. Save he rule
7. See that the discount is not applied to the product. (table `ps_specific_price` is empty)

#### Additional information

The problem happens because `getAffectedProducts` method uses `Context::getContext()->shop->id` instead of the selected shop id.

title: Fix position of cart crosselling hook
issue_title: [FO] - Cross selling practically impossible with current Classic theme setup
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Is your feature request related to a problem?

Featured products are hooked (besides `displayHome`) only to `displayCrossSellingShoppingCart` inside **cart-empty.tpl**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/50b0b86d86cb34fdcde04502fdc774bce8176ac5/themes/classic/templates/checkout/cart-empty.tpl#L28
which practically is never loaded (only way to open this page is to refresh the cart after you remove all the products - noone does that),
or to `displayOrderConfirmation2` inside **order-confirmation.tpl**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/50b0b86d86cb34fdcde04502fdc774bce8176ac5/themes/classic/templates/checkout/order-confirmation.tpl#L111
which loads only after the order has just been placed. It seems pointless at this stage as it forces the client, if interested in any of these products, to place another order and go through whole proccess again.

There's also **Cross selling** module available but this is hooked only to `displayFooterProduct` on main product page.

### Describe the solution you'd like

When a client adds a product to the cart or checks out cart later, then featured and/or crossselling products should be also loaded to provide possible new items for the cart, before the order is placed.

### Alternatives you've considered

![csps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5007456/142290505-bd1ec1e3-2094-4676-955c-042fdd9dcce8.gif)

title: Fix Combination::getIdByReference returns wrong id
issue_title: If ID_product is not defined, we can't find combination by reference
issue_body:
### Describe the bug

If there is one row in SQL table product_attribute that has id_product = 25 and reference = demo_10

Then if I run `$id = Combination::getIdByReference(25, 'demo_1');` this will return the above record because a LIKE is used in the query instead of a equality.

`$id = Combination::getIdByReference(25, 'demo_1');` should return a result if there is a row that has id_product = 25 and reference = demo_1 not demo_10

<hr>

#### Describe the bug

Actually, we can find a combination by reference only related to a specific product.
We could be retrieve combination in global context without take in consideration a specific product.

> Reported [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/26467) by @saiif

Combination::getIdByReference() returns wrong id 

#### Expected behavior

$id = Combination::getIdByReference(500);
return the same id 
$id = Combination::getIdByReference(5000);
cause like is used for the query 

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

$id = Combination::getIdByReference(500);
return the same id 
$id = Combination::getIdByReference(5000);

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Search reference without provide a product information
You can follow this [comment](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/20454#issuecomment-668689318)

Not relevant

title: Fix SQL query in OrderQueryBuilder
issue_title: BO - Orders - impossible to extend order grid query from module
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When you try to modify Orders list query from a module using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook, always gets an error by using the "New client" filter.

#### Expected behavior

A module could extend orders list query using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook with no errors.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Develop a module to add a new column on backoffice Orders grid using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook.
2. Add a new data column to Orders grid (similar to example for Customers grid from official doc: https://devdocs.prestashop.com/1.7/modules/sample-modules/grid-and-identifiable-object-form-hooks-usage/#extending-grid-query-builder)
2. Click on backoffice Orders menu
3. Use "New client" filter with any value (Yes or No) and click on Search button
4. An error 500 is shown due to and incorrect table alias

**Screenshots**

- Module hooks code:
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567527-49093a00-c9e4-11eb-9d18-16fa920a64ad.JPG)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567547-4dcdee00-c9e4-11eb-9236-9edd66e36a34.JPG)

hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier code:
```
public function hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier(array $params)
{
    $definition = $params['definition'];

    $definition->getColumns()->addAfter(
        'date_add',
        (new BooleanColumn('from_app'))
            ->setName($this->l('App order'))
            ->setOptions([
                'field' => 'from_app',
                'true_name' => $this->trans('Yes', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'false_name' => $this->trans('No', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'clickable' => true,
            ])
    );

    $definition->getFilters()->add(
        (new Filter('from_app', YesAndNoChoiceType::class))
        ->setTypeOptions([
            'required' => false,
        ])    
        ->setAssociatedColumn('from_app')
    );
}

public function hookActionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier(array $params)
{
    $searchQueryBuilder = $params['search_query_builder'];

    $searchCriteria = $params['search_criteria'];

    $searchQueryBuilder->addSelect(
        'app.`id_order` IS NOT NULL AS `from_app`'
    );

    $searchQueryBuilder->leftJoin(
        'o',
        '`app_order_table`',
        'app',
        'app.`id_order` = o.`id_order`'
    );

    if ('from_app' === $searchCriteria->getOrderBy()) {
        $searchQueryBuilder->orderBy('app.`id_order`', $searchCriteria->getOrderWay());
    }

    foreach ($searchCriteria->getFilters() as $filterName => $filterValue) {
        if ('from_app' === $filterName) {
            $searchQueryBuilder->andWhere('app.`id_order` IS ' . ($filterValue ? 'NOT' : '') . ' NULL');
        }
    }
}
```
- Error details:
![3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567574-58888300-c9e4-11eb-848c-f746a80b4062.JPG)

#### Additional information

A further investigation show that error came from leftJoin alias used on $searchQueryBuilder modification. The problem is that standard "o" alias completly change on query builder when a "New client" filter is used. This is caused by an incorrect subquery that do not use standard "o" alias (in fact do not use any alias at all) on https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/src/Core/Grid/Query/OrderQueryBuilder.php#L275. title: Do not use virtual cart for saving quantity in stock
issue_title: OrderDetail->product_quantity_in_stock is wrong
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
This commit screwed up the logic of computing items-in-stock quantity.
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/64e6f9e1d4068bd1ebab78c089e08d16c928fcd9#diff-706c99b0aadf150c801cec8a83a90cc1

Wrong line (1.7.6.2):
`$product_quantity = (int)Product::getQuantity($this->product_id, $this->product_attribute_id, null, $cart);`

Correctly functioning (from 1.6.1.23):
`$product_quantity = (int)Product::getQuantity($this->product_id, $this->product_attribute_id);`

**To Reproduce**
1. Make a product, set quantity to 1.
2. Check ps_stock_available, search the id_product, should be like this: quantity: 1, physical_quantity: 1, reserved_quantity: 0.
3. Order 1 piece of the product.
4. Go to order detail in BO, you will see a warning that the product you ordered was not/is not in stock. You also won't see the blue circle under the products quantity in the product list.
5. Check ps_order_detail, search the id_product and id_order, you will find **product_quantity: 1, product_quantity_in_stock: 0**.  But it should be **product_quantity: 1, product_quantity_in_stock: 1**.
6. Now, try it in older Prestashop or try it with the mentioned line change in classes/order/OrderDetail.php. It will work fine.

I do not want to make a PR, I don't know why this change was introduced, but on my side, I reverted it and I don't see any abnormalities.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.2

title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

When exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range), the footer of the following invoice is shown on the current invoice erroneously. This meant that in a multi-store environment, the wrong store details could be output on the invoice footer, which can create a compliance issue, especially if different tax information should be displayed. The issue resolves around the use of TCPDF, where the footer needs to be output after AddPage, otherwise the last page of a page group will end up having the footer of the next page group.

#### Expected behaviour

The footer should be output using the correct store details.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. In a multi-store environment -- set up multiple stores with different data, such that the footers on invoices would differ depending on which store items were ordered from
2. Place and invoice a mixture of orders - switch between stores when placing orders
3. Export orders using the invoices by date range functionality
4. Where invoices switch between stores, the footer belonging to the store of the next invoice will be shown on the current invoice

I will submit a pull request with a fix.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.8 (although also in previous versions)
* PHP version: 7.3.29

Any module or function that uses the native core PrestaShop function "isDiscounted" from the Product class will rise a Notice because an uncontrolled condition inside that function that rely that you have a cart already, but in many cases you will not.

Not any warning.

title: Fixes error which occurred when you try to modify any customer information after the import
issue_title: An unexpected error occurred when you try to modify any customer information after the import
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

Error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values` when modify and save customer information in BO. 

Error arrive because of invalid value of field `date_add" = 0000-00-00 00:00:00`.  If change this value to real date directly in DB, error disappear.  When we import customers, **Registration date** is used for `date_add`, so autodate is `false`, and `date_upd` is `0000-00-00 00:00:00`. Why not to set `date_upd` => `date('Y-m-d H:i:s')`, in `self::$default_values` in AdminImportController.php ?

#### Expected behavior

No error when save customer information.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to **Advanced Parameters** - **Import** , and import **Customers**. You can use sample **csv** file. 
2. Go to **Customers** page, open Edit customer page.
3. Try to save customer information. Not necessary to modify something.
4. See error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values`.
If customer is created directly in **BO** or **FO**, there is no such error.

**Screenshots**

title: Don't check if an invalid address exists over and over again
issue_title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)


### Expected behavior

Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.7.8.0

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.3

- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

When Prestashop is configured so that it does not use decimals, when validating the order with the 'validateOrder' method, the order is marked with payment error (PS_OS_ERROR)

on line 323 the error is thrown
```php
if ($order_status->logable && number_format($cart_total_paid, Context::getContext()->getComputingPrecision()) != number_format($amount_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_)) {
    $id_order_state = Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR');
}
```

In the if, the amount is validated with the constant _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ and the configuration of the currency is not checked. In this case the variable **_$cart_total_paid_** always has a difference with the amount paid (**_number_format($amount_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_)_**).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36648048/140820904-b65822bc-b83f-408d-860b-94b7ed222edf.png)


### Expected behavior

The order is marked with the correct status

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install clean Prestashop versión >= 1.7.8.0.
2. Create currency without decimal and set as default.
3. Install the `Payment by check` and enable it or use a payment method that set the status of payment in `payment accepted (ps_order_state id 2)` or `Processing in progress (ps_order_state id 3)`.
3. Create an publish product with price lower than $1000.
4. Create and publish product with price higher than $1000.
5. Buy a product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with a price less than $ 1000. It should work fine.
6. Purchase product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with price higher than $1000. This will fail and set order to Payment Error state.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.7.8.0

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.3

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

Prestashop is repeating this query several dozens of times
```
SELECT active
FROM `ps_hook` h
WHERE (h.name = "**") LIMIT 1
```
The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page:
![2021-11-25_111717](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143424749-7ccd8bfc-e566-47f7-8e4f-b5d45f790f53.jpg)

Query once the table ps_hook. Then a simple `in_array($hook_name, $active_hooks)` will do it. This can save dozens of queries depending on the page, even more than hundred (/!\) on a category page.

issue_title: [Multistore] - Product on category page display out of stock flag instead of availlable on order
issue_body:
### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots >Edited by Khouloud Steps to reproduce the issue: 1. Enable Multistore & Create new Group shop with Share quantity = enabled 2. Create a shop assiciated to this Group shop 3. Create a product with quantity = 0 & allowed for order 4. Go to FO of the shop2 > Category list 5. See error > The product is displayed with out-of-stock flag ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/153606126-320f965a-e2e0-4302-b44a-9dd91f947656.png) Hello, i'm back with my bug and i found the cause: On catagory page i have product display as out of stock even if the product is availlable for order. But if I access to the product page, status is ok and product can be added on cart. More, when I add the product to cart, the status on category page change for the good status until the product are removed from the cart. Not all product are affected. I searched in code and the problem come from the out_of_sotck parameter to define if you can order product out of stock. For some product the value of out_of_stock is empty on category page instead of 0,1 or 2. In this case it should be 1. **Product.php line 5579:** ` $row['allow_oosp'] = Product::isAvailableWhenOutOfStock($row['out_of_stock']);` Problem is only on category page. Home page, product page, search page are ok. To avoid loosing customer i disable message on category page ![123515636-7b7b8e00-d698-11eb-853f-76c3ce5b1a0c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675137-c44cd4ee-ffaf-4ccd-960f-0c635e5b574b.png) ![128632685-d1507f7f-9bf3-4c52-8459-34b62a81d6ac](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675149-ebaed18e-23ac-48ef-9cbf-82baae25733f.png) ![128632731-46a0e0c9-5313-4dec-85c8-4040db14b05a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675154-59fd6ed0-5b2b-4ae7-8363-faadd7b23f43.png) ![128632843-5d73b17b-3530-48b5-939e-0583711376be](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675158-4444a40f-40ce-4183-8e0b-edaba510dff0.png) I try to come back on the classic theme to identify if the problem occurs too. At first glance, no message is displaying and it seems to be normal. But classic theme doesn't display out of stock or allows order by default. If stock equal 0, no message is displayed. I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach}
{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {if $product.quantity > 0} {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach} {else} {if !$product.allow_oosp}
  • {$product.availability_message}
    • {/if} {/if}
{/block} ``` **Root cause :** After a long investigation, i found that : On class ProductAssemblerCore (ProductAssembler.php in classes foler), there is a SQL request that seach information for product. This request seach stock information by product shop and don't take account that stock is configurated to share stock 👍 ``` LEFT JOIN {$prefix}stock_available sa ON sa.id_product = p.id_product AND sa.id_shop = $idShop ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675471-d815e5f1-9383-4833-ae81-d25d5d5c89ac.png) So on category page for shared stock management between shop, information about stock are wrong ### Expected behavior When a product is availlable for order even if its qty equal 0, display on demand on category page. ### Steps to reproduce **You need to have multishop with shared product stock** 1. Define product witch capability to be order even if stock are equal to 0 2. Define stock to 0 3. Show product on category page 4. Flag is out of stock instead of On-demand ### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened 1.7.8.3 ### PHP version(s) where the bug happened 7.4 ### If your bug is related to a module, specify its name and its version _No response_
